<script id="app-script">
"use strict";
const APP_JS_SOURCE = document.currentScript ? document.currentScript.textContent : "";

/* ============ utilities ============ */
function uid(p){return (p||"id") + "_" + Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7);}
function esc(s){
  s = (s===undefined||s===null) ? "" : String(s);
  return s.replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/</g,"&lt;").replace(/>/g,"&gt;")
          .replace(/"/g,"&quot;").replace(/'/g,"&#39;");
}
function clone(o){return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(o));}
function nowISO(){return new Date().toISOString();}
function delay(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms);});}
const WEEKDAYS = ["Sun","Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri","Sat"];
function fmtDate(isoDate){
  if(!isoDate) return "";
  const d = new Date(isoDate + "T00:00:00");
  if(isNaN(d.getTime())) return isoDate;
  return (d.getMonth()+1) + "/" + d.getDate() + " (" + WEEKDAYS[d.getDay()] + ")";
}
function fmtDateTime(iso){
  if(!iso) return "";
  const d = new Date(iso);
  if(isNaN(d.getTime())) return iso;
  const p = function(n){return String(n).padStart(2,"0");};
  return (d.getMonth()+1)+"/"+d.getDate()+" "+p(d.getHours())+":"+p(d.getMinutes());
}
function sha256Hex(str){
  const enc = new TextEncoder().encode(str);
  return crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", enc).then(function(buf){
    return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf)).map(function(b){return b.toString(16).padStart(2,"0");}).join("");
  });
}
function safeJsonForScript(obj){
  return JSON.stringify(obj).replace(/</g,"\\u003c").replace(/-->/g,"--\\u003e");
}
function parseShuttleTripsText(text){
  return String(text||"").split("\n").map(function(line){return line.trim();}).filter(Boolean).map(function(line){
    const parts = line.split(",").map(function(p){return p.trim();});
    return {a: parts[0]||"", b: parts[1]||"", label: parts[2]||""};
  });
}
function shuttleTripsToText(trips){
  return (trips||[]).map(function(t){return [t.a||"", t.b||"", t.label||""].join(",");}).join("\n");
}

/* ============ load state ============ */
// Backward-compatible shape guard: state saved before a feature (speakers,
// FAQ, logistics, groups, questions, updatedAt tracking) was added is missing
// those keys entirely. Every render/reducer function assumes they exist, so
// fill in safe empty defaults right after loading rather than guarding every
// call site individually.
function ensureStateShape(s){
  if(!s.logistics || typeof s.logistics !== "object") s.logistics = {};
  if(!Array.isArray(s.speakers)) s.speakers = [];
  if(!Array.isArray(s.faqs)) s.faqs = [];
  if(!Array.isArray(s.questions)) s.questions = [];
  if(!Array.isArray(s.groups)) s.groups = [];
  if(!Array.isArray(s.visitSites)) s.visitSites = [];
  if(!s.shuttle || typeof s.shuttle !== "object") s.shuttle = {};
  if(!s.shuttle.outbound || typeof s.shuttle.outbound !== "object") s.shuttle.outbound = {stopA:"",stopB:"",trips:[],directionsUrl:""};
  if(!Array.isArray(s.shuttle.outbound.trips)) s.shuttle.outbound.trips = [];
  if(!("directionsUrl" in s.shuttle.outbound)) s.shuttle.outbound.directionsUrl = DEFAULT_OUTBOUND_DIRECTIONS_URL;
  if(!s.shuttle.inbound || typeof s.shuttle.inbound !== "object") s.shuttle.inbound = {stopA:"",stopB:"",trips:[],directionsUrl:""};
  if(!Array.isArray(s.shuttle.inbound.trips)) s.shuttle.inbound.trips = [];
  if(!("directionsUrl" in s.shuttle.inbound)) s.shuttle.inbound.directionsUrl = DEFAULT_INBOUND_DIRECTIONS_URL;
  if(!s.meta || typeof s.meta !== "object") s.meta = {version:1, isSample:false, createdAt: nowISO()};
  if(!s.meta.updatedAt) s.meta.updatedAt = s.meta.createdAt || nowISO();
  if(!s.fieldWork || typeof s.fieldWork !== "object") s.fieldWork = {baseMapImageUrl:""};
  if(!("baseMapImageUrl" in s.fieldWork)) s.fieldWork.baseMapImageUrl = "";
  if(!Array.isArray(s.fieldZones)){
    // Older saved states (before Zone Management shipped) have no fieldZones
    // at all -- seed the same three zones that used to be hardcoded, so a
    // page saved under the previous version doesn't lose its Field Work
    // content when it loads under this one.
    s.fieldZones = [
      {id:uid("fz"), key:"A", color:"a", titleEn:"Reviving the Waterway Image", titleZh:"水系意象的再現",
       subtitleEn:"", subtitleZh:"",
       boundaryEn:"Mapped to the Fu'an-keng Creek corridor", boundaryZh:"對應福安坑溪水系紋理",
       groupLabel:"", descEn:"", descZh:""},
      {id:uid("fz"), key:"B", color:"b", titleEn:"Reimagining the Xiaoxi Gate Gateway", titleZh:"小西門舊歷史街區入口意象再造",
       subtitleEn:"", subtitleZh:"",
       boundaryEn:"Ximen Rd \u00b7 Bao'an Rd \u00b7 Xiaoxi Gate Roundabout", boundaryZh:"對應西門路／保安路／小西門圓環",
       groupLabel:"", descEn:"", descZh:""},
      {id:uid("fz"), key:"C", color:"c", titleEn:"Future Streetscape of the Old Blocks", titleZh:"舊街廓未來景觀樣貌",
       subtitleEn:"", subtitleZh:"",
       boundaryEn:"Mapped to historic lanes and block boundaries", boundaryZh:"對應歷史街巷與邊界",
       groupLabel:"", descEn:"", descZh:""}
    ];
  }
  return s;
}
function loadInitialState(){
  try{
    const raw = document.getElementById("app-state").textContent;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    if(parsed && parsed.course && Array.isArray(parsed.schedule)){
      return ensureStateShape(parsed);
    }
  }catch(e){ /* fall through to default */ }
  return ensureStateShape(buildDefaultState());
}

let STATE = loadInitialState();

/* ============ persistence: action log ============ */
const FIELD_ALIASES = {
  course:{
    title:["課程名稱","課程標題","名稱","課程"],
    subtitle:["副標題","梯次","課程期別"],
    description:["課程簡介","簡介","課程介紹","說明","課程說明"],
    dateRange:["上課日期","課程日期","日期區間","開課日期","日期"],
    location:["上課地點","地點","教室"],
    slidesUrl:["簡報連結","投影片連結","簡報","slides","講義連結"],
    photosUrl:["照片連結","相簿連結","相片","photos","照片","相簿"],
    contactNote:["備註","提醒事項","其他說明","注意事項"]
  },

    date:["日期","上課日期","date"],
    start:["開始時間","起始時間","上課時間","時間","start"],
    end:["結束時間","下課時間","end"],
    topic:["主題","課程內容","課程主題","內容","topic","subject","課程"],
    location:["地點","教室","location"],
    note:["備註","note","remark"]
  },
  roster:{
    no:["學號","座號","編號","no","student no","id"],
    name:["姓名","名字","name"]
  }
};
function normLabel(s){
  return String(s===undefined||s===null?"":s).trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[\s　]/g,"");
}
function matchAlias(label, aliasMap){
  const n = normLabel(label);
  if(!n) return null;
  for(const field in aliasMap){
    const list = aliasMap[field];
    for(let i=0;i<list.length;i++){
      if(normLabel(list[i])===n) return field;
    }
  }
  // Fuzzy (substring) matching only kicks in for aliases of 3+ characters:
  // very short aliases (e.g. "地點", "教室", "日期") turn up as a substring of
  // many unrelated real-world labels ("實地參訪地點", "住宿地點", "集合時間"...)
  // and would otherwise mis-tag them.
  for(const field in aliasMap){
    const list = aliasMap[field];
    for(let i=0;i<list.length;i++){
      const a = normLabel(list[i]);
      if(a && a.length>=3 && (n.indexOf(a)>-1 || a.indexOf(n)>-1)) return field;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/* ============ reducer ============ */
function applyAction(state, action){
  const s = state;
  switch(action.type){
    case "SET_COURSE":
      s.course = Object.assign({}, s.course, action.payload);
      s.meta.isSample = false;
      break;
    case "IMPORT_EXCEL":
      if(action.payload.course) s.course = Object.assign({}, s.course, action.payload.course);
      if(action.payload.schedule) s.schedule = action.payload.schedule;
      if(action.payload.students) s.students = action.payload.students;
      s.meta.isSample = false;
      break;
    case "SCHEDULE_UPSERT": {
      const row = action.payload;
      const idx = s.schedule.findIndex(function(r){return r.id===row.id;});
      if(idx>-1) s.schedule[idx] = row; else s.schedule.push(row);
      s.schedule.sort(function(a,b){
        return (a.date+a.start).localeCompare(b.date+b.start);
      });
      s.meta.isSample = false;
      break;
    }
    case "SCHEDULE_DELETE":
      s.schedule = s.schedule.filter(function(r){return r.id!==action.payload.id;});
      break;
    case "ANN_UPSERT": {
      const row = action.payload;
      const idx = s.announcements.findIndex(function(r){return r.id===row.id;});
      if(idx>-1) s.announcements[idx] = row; else s.announcements.unshift(row);
      s.meta.isSample = false;
      break;
    }
    case "ANN_DELETE":
      s.announcements = s.announcements.filter(function(r){return r.id!==action.payload.id;});
      break;
    case "ANN_TOGGLE_PIN": {
      const a = s.announcements.find(function(r){return r.id===action.payload.id;});
      if(a) a.pinned = !a.pinned;
      break;
    }
    case "ASSIGN_UPSERT": {
      const row = action.payload;
      const idx = s.assignments.findIndex(function(r){return r.id===row.id;});
      if(idx>-1) s.assignments[idx] = row; else s.assignments.push(row);
      s.meta.isSample = false;
      break;
    }
    case "ASSIGN_DELETE":
      s.assignments = s.assignments.filter(function(r){return r.id!==action.payload.id;});
      s.submissions = s.submissions.filter(function(r){return r.assignmentId!==action.payload.id;});
      break;
    case "STUDENT_UPSERT": {
      const row = action.payload;
      const idx = s.students.findIndex(function(r){return r.id===row.id;});
      if(idx>-1) s.students[idx] = row; else s.students.push(row);
      s.meta.isSample = false;
      break;
    }
    case "STUDENT_DELETE":
      s.students = s.students.filter(function(r){return r.id!==action.payload.id;});
      break;
    case "SUBMIT_ASSIGNMENT": {
      const p = action.payload;
      const idx = s.submissions.findIndex(function(r){
        return r.assignmentId===p.assignmentId && r.studentNo===p.studentNo;
      });
      const row = {
        id: idx>-1 ? s.submissions[idx].id : uid("sub"),
        assignmentId: p.assignmentId, studentNo: p.studentNo, studentName: p.studentName,
        studentGroup: p.studentGroup||"", note: p.note||"", submittedAt: nowISO()
      };
      if(idx>-1) s.submissions[idx] = row; else s.submissions.push(row);
      break;
    }
    case "SET_PASSWORD":
      s.admin.passwordHash = action.payload.hash;
      s.admin.passwordSet = true;
      break;
    case "LOGISTICS_SET":
      s.logistics = Object.assign({}, s.logistics, action.payload);
      break;
    case "SPEAKER_UPSERT": {
      const row = action.payload;
      const idx = s.speakers.findIndex(function(r){return r.id===row.id;});
      if(idx>-1) s.speakers[idx] = row; else s.speakers.push(row);
      break;
    }
    case "SPEAKER_DELETE":
      s.speakers = s.speakers.filter(function(r){return r.id!==action.payload.id;});
      break;
    case "FAQ_UPSERT": {
      const row = action.payload;
      const idx = s.faqs.findIndex(function(r){return r.id===row.id;});
      if(idx>-1) s.faqs[idx] = row; else s.faqs.push(row);
      break;
    }
    case "FAQ_DELETE":
      s.faqs = s.faqs.filter(function(r){return r.id!==action.payload.id;});
      break;
    case "GROUP_UPSERT": {
      const row = action.payload;
      const idx = s.groups.findIndex(function(r){return r.id===row.id;});
      if(idx>-1) s.groups[idx] = row; else s.groups.push(row);
      break;
    }
    case "GROUP_DELETE":
      s.groups = s.groups.filter(function(r){return r.id!==action.payload.id;});
      break;
    case "QUESTION_SUBMIT":
      s.questions.push(action.payload);
      break;
    case "QUESTION_REPLY": {
      const q = s.questions.find(function(r){return r.id===action.payload.id;});
      if(q){ q.reply = action.payload.reply; q.repliedAt = nowISO(); }
      break;
    }
    case "QUESTION_DELETE":
      s.questions = s.questions.filter(function(r){return r.id!==action.payload.id;});
      break;
    case "VISITSITE_UPSERT": {
      const row = action.payload;
      const idx = s.visitSites.findIndex(function(r){return r.id===row.id;});
      if(idx>-1) s.visitSites[idx] = row; else s.visitSites.push(row);
      break;
    }
    case "VISITSITE_DELETE":
      s.visitSites = s.visitSites.filter(function(r){return r.id!==action.payload.id;});
      break;
    case "SHUTTLE_SET":
      s.shuttle = action.payload;
      break;
    case "ZONE_UPSERT": {
      const row = action.payload;
      const idx = s.fieldZones.findIndex(function(r){return r.id===row.id;});
      if(idx>-1) s.fieldZones[idx] = row; else s.fieldZones.push(row);
      break;
    }
    case "ZONE_DELETE":
      s.fieldZones = s.fieldZones.filter(function(r){return r.id!==action.payload.id;});
      break;
    case "FIELDWORK_SET":
      s.fieldWork = Object.assign({}, s.fieldWork, action.payload);
      break;
  }
  s.meta.updatedAt = nowISO();
  return s;
}

/* ============ full document builder (for self-publish) ============ */
const BODY_SHELL = '<div id="app"></div>\n<div id="toast-root"></div>';
function buildFullDocument(state){
  const styleTag = document.getElementById("app-style").outerHTML;
  const xlsxTag = document.getElementById("xlsx-lib").outerHTML;
  const qrTag = document.getElementById("qrcode-lib").outerHTML;
  const fontTag = '<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Serif+TC:wght@600;700&family=Noto+Sans+TC:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap">';
  const titleText = esc((state.course && state.course.title) || "Course Portal") + " | Course Portal";
  const stateJson = safeJsonForScript(state);
  return "<!doctype html>\n<html lang=\"en\">\n<head>\n" +
    "<meta charset=\"utf-8\">\n" +
    "<meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover\">\n" +
    "<title>" + titleText + "</title>\n" +
    styleTag + "\n" + fontTag + "\n" +
    "</head>\n<body>\n" + BODY_SHELL + "\n" +
    "<script id=\"app-state\" type=\"application/json\">" + stateJson + "<" + "/script>\n" +
    xlsxTag + "\n" + qrTag + "\n" +
    "<script id=\"app-script\">" + APP_JS_SOURCE + "<" + "/script>\n" +
    "</body>\n</html>";
}

/* ============ publish / dispatch ============ */
let pendingRetryCount = 0;
async function tryPublish(){
  let artifact = null;
  try{ artifact = await window.claude.use("artifact"); }catch(e){ artifact = null; }
  if(!artifact){
    try{ sessionStorage.removeItem("courseportal_pending_action"); }catch(e){}
    return;
  }
  try{
    const html = buildFullDocument(STATE);
    await artifact.publish(html);
    try{ sessionStorage.removeItem("courseportal_pending_action"); }catch(e){}
    pendingRetryCount = 0;
  }catch(err){
    const code = err && err.code;
    if(code==="conflict"){
      return; // this view is already reloading to the winning version
    }
    if(code==="not_writer" || code==="not_granted"){
      READ_ONLY = true;
      try{ sessionStorage.removeItem("courseportal_pending_action"); }catch(e){}
      showToast("This link is read-only. Submitting or editing needs an editable link. 此連結為唯讀模式，回報作業或編輯後台需要可編輯的連結。","danger");
      render();
      return;
    }
    if((code==="upstream_error" || code==="rate_limited") && pendingRetryCount<2){
      pendingRetryCount++;
      await delay(700 + Math.random()*500);
      return tryPublish();
    }
    showToast("Save failed, please try again later. 儲存失敗，請稍後再試一次。","danger");
  }
}
async function dispatch(action){
  if(READ_ONLY){
    showToast("This link is read-only and cannot be edited. 此連結為唯讀模式，無法編輯。","danger");
    return;
  }
  STATE = applyAction(clone(STATE), action);
  UI.modal = null;
  try{
    pendingRetryCount = 0;
    sessionStorage.setItem("courseportal_pending_action", JSON.stringify({action:action, attempts:1}));
  }catch(e){}
  render();
  await tryPublish();
}

/* ============ toast ============ */
let toastTimer = null;
function showToast(msg, kind){
  UI.toast = {msg:msg, kind:kind||"default"};
  renderToast();
  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  toastTimer = setTimeout(function(){ UI.toast=null; renderToast(); }, 3200);
}
function renderToast(){
  const root = document.getElementById("toast-root");
  if(!root) return;
  if(!UI.toast){ root.innerHTML=""; return; }
  const cls = UI.toast.kind==="danger" ? "toast toast-danger" : (UI.toast.kind==="success" ? "toast toast-success":"toast");
  root.innerHTML = '<div class="'+cls+'">'+esc(UI.toast.msg)+'</div>';
}

/* ============ due status ============ */
function dueStatus(dueAt){
  if(!dueAt) return {label:'No deadline <span class="zh">無截止</span>', cls:"pill-muted"};
  const now = new Date(); const due = new Date(dueAt);
  const diff = due.getTime() - now.getTime();
  if(diff < 0) return {label:'Closed <span class="zh">已截止</span>', cls:"pill-danger"};
  if(diff < 24*3600*1000) return {label:'Due soon <span class="zh">即將截止</span>', cls:"pill-warning"};
  return {label:'Open <span class="zh">進行中</span>', cls:"pill-accent"};
}

/* ============ student identity (per-viewer convenience) ============ */
function loadIdentity(){
  try{
    const raw = localStorage.getItem("courseportal_identity");
    if(raw) return JSON.parse(raw);
  }catch(e){}
  return {no:"", name:""};
}
function saveIdentity(id){
  try{ localStorage.setItem("courseportal_identity", JSON.stringify(id)); }catch(e){}
}
let IDENTITY = loadIdentity();

/* ============ due countdown ============ */
function fmtCountdown(dueAt){
  if(!dueAt) return "";
  const due = new Date(dueAt);
  if(isNaN(due.getTime())) return "";
  const diff = due.getTime() - Date.now();
  const abs = Math.abs(diff);
  const days = Math.floor(abs/86400000);
  const hours = Math.floor((abs%86400000)/3600000);
  const mins = Math.floor((abs%3600000)/60000);
  const parts = [];
  if(days>0) parts.push(days+"d");
  if(days>0 || hours>0) parts.push(hours+"h");
  if(days===0) parts.push(mins+"m");
  const text = parts.join(" ");
  if(diff<0) return 'Overdue by '+text+' <span class="zh">已逾期 '+text+'</span>';
  return text+' left <span class="zh">剩 '+text+'</span>';
}
function updateCountdowns(){
  try{
    document.querySelectorAll(".countdown[data-due]").forEach(function(el){
      el.innerHTML = fmtCountdown(el.getAttribute("data-due"));
    });
  }catch(e){}
}
setInterval(updateCountdowns, 30000);

  const root = document.getElementById("app");
  if(!root) return;
  root.innerHTML = renderTopBar() +
    '<div class="shell">' + renderBanners() + renderMain() + renderFooter() + '</div>' +
    renderModal();
  renderToast();
  drawShareQr();
}

function renderAnnouncementTeaser(){
  const list = STATE.announcements.slice().sort(function(a,b){
    if(!!a.pinned!==!!b.pinned) return a.pinned? -1:1;
    return b.createdAt.localeCompare(a.createdAt);
  });
  const head = '<div class="section-head section-head-accent"><div>'+
    '<div class="eyebrow">Real-Time Hub <span class="zh">即時動態</span></div>'+
    '<h2 class="section-title">Latest Announcements <span class="zh">最新公告</span></h2></div></div>';
  if(!list.length){
    return head+
      '<div class="card"><div class="empty">No announcements yet <span class="zh">目前尚無最新公告</span></div></div>';
  }
  const a = list[0];
  return head+
    '<div class="card'+(a.pinned?' ann-teaser-pinned':'')+'">'+
    (a.pinned? '<span class="pill pill-stamp">Pinned <span class="zh">置頂</span></span>':'')+
    '<div class="ann-teaser-title" style="margin-top:'+(a.pinned?'6px':'0')+';">'+esc(a.title)+'</div>'+
    '<div class="ann-teaser-date">'+esc(fmtDateTime(a.createdAt))+'</div>'+
    '<div class="ann-body">'+esc(a.body)+'</div>'+
    (a.url? '<div class="ann-link-row" style="margin-top:8px;"><a class="btn btn-sm" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="'+esc(a.url)+'">Open Link <span class="zh">開啟連結</span> ↗</a></div>':'')+
    '<div class="btn-row" style="margin-top:10px;"><button class="btn btn-sm" data-action="student-tab" data-tab="resources">View All <span class="zh">查看全部公告</span> →</button></div>'+
    '</div>';
}

function splitOverviewParagraphs(desc){
  const enCollabMarker = "Taiwanese and Japanese students";
  const zhCollabMarker = "活動期間";
  const zhMatch = desc.match(/[一-鿿]/);
  const zhStartIdx = zhMatch ? zhMatch.index : -1;
  const enCollabIdx = desc.indexOf(enCollabMarker);
  if(enCollabIdx===-1 || zhStartIdx===-1) return {concept: desc, collab: ""};
  const zhCollabIdx = desc.indexOf(zhCollabMarker, zhStartIdx);
  const enConcept = desc.slice(0, enCollabIdx).trim();
  const enCollab = desc.slice(enCollabIdx, zhStartIdx).trim();
  const zhConcept = zhCollabIdx>-1 ? desc.slice(zhStartIdx, zhCollabIdx).trim() : desc.slice(zhStartIdx).trim();
  const zhCollab = zhCollabIdx>-1 ? desc.slice(zhCollabIdx).trim() : "";
  return {
    concept: (enConcept + " " + zhConcept).trim(),
    collab: (enCollab + " " + zhCollab).trim()
  };
}

function renderOverviewPillars(){
  const items = [
    ["Hydrological Network","水系紋理再造","Tracing Fu'an-keng Creek's hidden channels and their relationship to the city's blue-green corridor.","追溯福安坑溪隱密水道與都市藍綠帶關係。"],
    ["City Wall Boundaries","歷史城郭邊界","Examining the remnants and shifting boundary of the old city wall from the Great South Gate to Xiaoxi Gate.","探討大南門至小西門段的城牆遺構與邊界變遷。"],
    ["Neighborhood Life","街區生活場域","Observing everyday life and present-day vitality around Youai Market and the former prison district.","觀察友愛市場與舊刑務所周邊的日常場域與當代活力。"],

  ];
  return '<div class="pillar-grid">'+items.map(function(it){

}

function splitSpeakerName(name){
  // Splits a leading run of CJK (Han/Hiragana/Katakana) characters — the
  // primary display name — from a trailing romanization/Japanese-reading
  // portion, e.g. "小野尋子 Ono Hiroko （オノ　ヒロコ）" -> ["小野尋子","Ono Hiroko （オノ　ヒロコ）"].
  // Names with no trailing portion (e.g. "蔡宜珊") just return an empty sub.
  const s = String(name||"").trim();
  const m = /^([一-鿿ぁ-んァ-ヶー]+)\s*([\s\S]*)$/.exec(s);
  if(!m) return {main:s, sub:""};
  return {main:m[1], sub:m[2]||""};
}
function renderSpeakersSection(){
  const list = STATE.speakers||[];
  if(!list.length) return "";
  const cards = list.map(function(sp){
    const initial = esc((sp.name||"?").trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase());
    const avatar = sp.photoUrl?
      '<img class="speaker-avatar" src="'+esc(sp.photoUrl)+'" alt="">' :
      '<div class="speaker-avatar-fallback">'+initial+'</div>';
    const nameParts = splitSpeakerName(sp.name);
    return '<div class="speaker-card">'+avatar+
      '<div class="speaker-card-body"><div class="speaker-name">'+esc(nameParts.main)+'</div>'+
      (nameParts.sub? '<div class="speaker-name-sub">'+esc(nameParts.sub)+'</div>':'')+
      (sp.title? '<div class="speaker-title">'+esc(sp.title)+'</div>':'')+
      (sp.bio? '<div class="speaker-bio">'+esc(sp.bio)+'</div>':'')+
      '</div></div>';
  }).join("");
  return '<section class="section"><div class="section-head"><div>' +
    '<div class="eyebrow">Speakers <span class="zh">講者介紹</span></div><h2 class="section-title">Instructors &amp; Speakers</h2></div></div>' +
    '<div class="card"><div class="speaker-grid">'+cards+'</div></div></section>';
}

function visitSiteMapUrl(v){
  if(v.url) return v.url;
  if(!v.name) return "";
  return "https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query="+encodeURIComponent(v.name);
}
function busStopMapUrl(name){
  if(!name) return "";
  // Strip a bilingual "中文名 English name" pair down to the Chinese portion
  // (or the whole string if there isn't one) before appending "公車站" so the
  // Google Maps search targets the actual bus stop rather than the raw label.
  const zhPart = (/^([^\x00-\x7F]+)/.exec(name)||[])[1] || name;
  return "https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query="+encodeURIComponent(zhPart.trim()+" 公車站");
}
function extractRouteNumbers(trips){
  // Bus route numbers actually in use for this direction, taken from each
  // trip's label (e.g. "902 去程" -> "902"). A direction can be served by
  // more than one route (e.g. 101/105/107 on the return leg), so this is a
  // real list of routes rather than a single fabricated route number.
  const seen = [];
  (trips||[]).forEach(function(t){
    const m = /^(\S+)/.exec(String(t.label||"").trim());
    const num = m ? m[1] : "";
    if(num && seen.indexOf(num)===-1) seen.push(num);
  });
  return seen;
}
function renderShuttleDirection(dir, dirLabelEn, dirLabelZh){
  const trips = (dir&&dir.trips)||[];
  const stopA = (dir&&dir.stopA)||"";
  const stopB = (dir&&dir.stopB)||"";
  const count = trips.length;
  const routes = extractRouteNumbers(trips);
  const stopLink = function(name){
    if(!name) return '—';
    const url = busStopMapUrl(name);
    return '<a class="field-transit-stop-link" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="'+esc(url)+'">'+esc(name)+'</a>';
  };
  const directionsUrl = (dir&&dir.directionsUrl)||"";
  const routeCard = (stopA||stopB)?
    '<div class="field-transit-route-card">'+
    '<div class="field-transit-route-head">'+
    '<div class="field-transit-route-label">'+esc(dirLabelEn)+' Bus Route <span class="zh">'+esc(dirLabelZh)+'公車路線</span></div>'+
    (directionsUrl? '<a class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="'+esc(directionsUrl)+'">Get Directions <span class="zh">路線導航</span> ↗</a>' : '')+
    '</div>'+
    '<div class="field-transit-route-stops">'+
    '<div class="field-transit-route-stop-row">'+stopLink(stopA)+'</div>'+
    '<div class="field-transit-route-arrow">→</div>'+
    '<div class="field-transit-route-stop-row">'+stopLink(stopB)+'</div>'+
    '</div>'+
    '</div>' : '';
  const body = (!trips.length && !stopA && !stopB) ?
    '<div class="empty">Not set yet <span class="zh">尚未建立</span></div>' :
    (routeCard+
    (trips.length?
      '<div class="field-transit-table-wrap table-wrap"><table class="data"><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>'+esc(stopA||"Stop A")+'</th><th>'+esc(stopB||"Stop B")+'</th><th>Bus 班次</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+
      trips.map(function(t,i){
        return '<tr><td class="num">'+(i+1)+'</td><td class="num">'+esc(t.a)+'</td><td class="num">'+esc(t.b)+'</td><td>'+esc(t.label)+'</td></tr>';
      }).join("")+
      '</tbody></table></div>' :
      '<div class="empty">No trips listed yet <span class="zh">尚未建立班次</span></div>'));
  const routeBadges = routes.map(function(r){ return '<span class="route-num-badge">'+esc(r)+' <span class="zh">路</span></span>'; }).join("");
  return '<div class="field-transit-col"><div class="field-transit-col-head">'+esc(dirLabelEn)+' <span class="zh">'+esc(dirLabelZh)+'</span>'+
    (count? ' <span class="pill pill-accent">'+count+' 班次</span>':'')+
    routeBadges+
    '</div>'+body+'</div>';
}

}

function getScheduleDays(){
  const dates = Array.from(new Set((STATE.schedule||[]).map(function(r){return r.date;}).filter(Boolean)));
  dates.sort();
  return dates;
}
function pickDefaultScheduleDay(){
  const days = getScheduleDays();
  if(!days.length) return "";
  const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
  if(days.indexOf(todayStr)>-1) return todayStr;
  return days[0];
}
function isSessionNow(r){
  if(!r.date || !r.start) return false;
  const start = new Date(r.date+"T"+r.start+":00");
  if(isNaN(start.getTime())) return false;
  const end = r.end ? new Date(r.date+"T"+r.end+":00") : new Date(start.getTime()+3600000);
  const now = new Date();
  return now>=start && now<=end;
}
function renderScheduleDayTabs(){
  const days = getScheduleDays();
  if(days.length<=1) return "";
  const selected = UI.scheduleDay || pickDefaultScheduleDay();
  const btns = days.map(function(d,i){
    return '<button class="tabbtn'+(selected===d?" active":"")+'" data-action="schedule-day" data-day="'+esc(d)+'">Day '+(i+1)+' <span class="zh">'+esc(fmtDate(d))+'</span></button>';
  }).join("");
  return '<div class="tabs" style="margin-top:0;margin-bottom:10px;">'+btns+'</div>';
}

/* ---- matrix / grid timetable view: days across the top, time down the
   side, like a university course-registration timetable. Best on desktop
   (wide enough to see every day at once); the list+day-tabs view above
   stays the default and works better on a phone. ---- */
function timeToMinutes(t){
  const m = /^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/.exec(String(t||""));
  if(!m) return null;
  return parseInt(m[1],10)*60 + parseInt(m[2],10);
}
function minutesToTime(mins){
  const h = Math.floor(mins/60), m = ((mins%60)+60)%60;
  return String(h).padStart(2,"0")+":"+String(m).padStart(2,"0");
}
function sessionEffectiveRange(r){
  const s = timeToMinutes(r.start);
  if(s===null) return null;
  const eRaw = r.end ? timeToMinutes(r.end) : null;
  const e = (eRaw===null || eRaw<=s) ? s+60 : eRaw;
  return {start:s, end:e};
}
function computeGridRange(rows){
  const SLOT = 10;
  let minStart = Infinity, maxEnd = -Infinity;
  rows.forEach(function(r){
    const rng = sessionEffectiveRange(r);
    if(!rng) return;
    if(rng.start<minStart) minStart=rng.start;
    if(rng.end>maxEnd) maxEnd=rng.end;
  });
  if(minStart===Infinity){ minStart=540; maxEnd=600; }
  minStart = Math.floor(minStart/SLOT)*SLOT;
  maxEnd = Math.ceil(maxEnd/SLOT)*SLOT;
  return {minStart:minStart, maxEnd:maxEnd, slot:SLOT};
}
function renderScheduleGrid(){
  const days = getScheduleDays();
  if(!days.length) return '<div class="empty">No sessions scheduled yet <span class="zh">尚未安排課表</span></div>';
  const withTimes = STATE.schedule.filter(function(r){return r.date && r.start;});
  const range = computeGridRange(withTimes);
  const SLOT = range.slot;
  const totalSlots = Math.max(1, Math.round((range.maxEnd-range.minStart)/SLOT));
  const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
  const colTemplate = "68px repeat("+days.length+", minmax(130px,1fr))";

  let html = "";
  html += '<div class="tg-cell tg-corner" style="grid-column:1;grid-row:1;"></div>';
  days.forEach(function(d,i){
    const isToday = d===todayStr;
    html += '<div class="tg-cell tg-daylabel'+(isToday?' tg-today':'')+'" style="grid-column:'+(i+2)+';grid-row:1;">Day '+(i+1)+' <span class="zh">'+esc(fmtDate(d))+'</span></div>';
  });
  const covered = days.map(function(){ return new Array(totalSlots).fill(false); });
  STATE.schedule.forEach(function(r){
    const dayIdx = days.indexOf(r.date);
    if(dayIdx<0) return;
    const rng = sessionEffectiveRange(r);
    if(!rng) return;
    const s = Math.round((rng.start-range.minStart)/SLOT);
    const span = Math.max(1, Math.round((rng.end-rng.start)/SLOT));
    for(let k=s;k<s+span;k++){ if(k>=0 && k<totalSlots) covered[dayIdx][k]=true; }
  });
  for(let i=0;i<totalSlots;i++){
    const t = range.minStart + i*SLOT;
    const isHour = (t%60===0);
    const rowIdx = i+2;
    html += '<div class="tg-cell tg-timeline'+(isHour?' tg-hour':'')+'" style="grid-column:1;grid-row:'+rowIdx+';">'+(isHour? esc(minutesToTime(t)):'')+'</div>';
    for(let c=0;c<days.length;c++){
      const empty = !covered[c][i];
      html += '<div class="tg-cell tg-slot'+(isHour?' tg-hour':'')+(empty?' tg-empty':'')+'" style="grid-column:'+(c+2)+';grid-row:'+rowIdx+';"></div>';
    }
  }
  STATE.schedule.forEach(function(r){
    const dayIdx = days.indexOf(r.date);
    if(dayIdx<0) return;
    const rng = sessionEffectiveRange(r);
    if(!rng) return;
    const rowStart = Math.round((rng.start-range.minStart)/SLOT)+2;
    const rowSpan = Math.max(1, Math.round((rng.end-rng.start)/SLOT));
    const current = isSessionNow(r);
    html += '<div class="tg-block'+(current?' tg-current':'')+'" style="grid-column:'+(dayIdx+2)+';grid-row:'+rowStart+' / span '+rowSpan+';">'+
      '<div class="tg-block-head"><span class="tg-block-time">'+esc(r.start)+(r.end? '–'+esc(r.end):'')+'</span>'+
      (current?' <span class="pill pill-stamp" style="padding:1px 6px;font-size:9px;">Now</span>':'')+'</div>'+
      '<div class="tg-block-topic">'+esc(r.topic)+'</div>'+
      ((r.location||r.note)? '<div class="tg-block-meta">'+
        (r.location? '<div class="tg-block-loc">'+esc(r.location)+'</div>':'')+
        (r.note? '<div class="tg-block-people">'+esc(r.note)+'</div>':'')+
        '</div>':'')+
      '</div>';
  });
  return '<div class="tg-wrap"><div class="timetable-grid" style="grid-template-columns:'+colTemplate+';grid-template-rows:auto repeat('+totalSlots+', minmax(20px, auto));">'+html+'</div></div>';
}
function renderScheduleViewToggle(){
  const days = getScheduleDays();
  if(days.length<=1) return "";
  const view = UI.scheduleView || "list";
  return '<div class="btn-row" style="margin-bottom:10px;">'+
    '<button class="btn btn-sm'+(view==="list"?" btn-primary":"")+'" data-action="schedule-view" data-view="list">List <span class="zh">列表</span></button>'+
    '<button class="btn btn-sm'+(view==="grid"?" btn-primary":"")+'" data-action="schedule-view" data-view="grid">Grid <span class="zh">表格</span></button>'+
    '</div>';
}
function renderScheduleSection(){
  const view = UI.scheduleView || "list";
  const days = getScheduleDays();
  let bodyHtml;
  if(view==="grid" && days.length>1){
    bodyHtml = renderScheduleGrid();
  } else {
    const selected = days.length ? (UI.scheduleDay || pickDefaultScheduleDay()) : "";
    const all = STATE.schedule.slice().sort(function(a,b){return (a.date+a.start).localeCompare(b.date+b.start);});
    const rows = selected ? all.filter(function(r){return r.date===selected;}) : all;
    const body = rows.length ? rows.map(function(r){
      const current = isSessionNow(r);
      return '<div class="sched-row'+(current?' sched-current':'')+'"><div class="sched-time-pill">'+
        '<span class="sched-start">'+esc(r.start)+'</span>'+
        (r.end? '<span class="sched-end">– '+esc(r.end)+'</span>':'')+'</div>' +
        '<div class="sched-body"><div class="sched-topic">'+esc(r.topic)+(current? ' <span class="pill pill-stamp">Now <span class="zh">進行中</span></span>':'')+'</div>' +
        '<div class="sched-meta">'+[r.location,r.note].filter(Boolean).map(esc).join(' · ')+'</div>'+
        '<a class="btn btn-sm btn-outline" style="margin-top:6px;" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="'+esc(gcalUrl(r))+'">+ Calendar <span class="zh">加入日曆</span></a>'+
        '</div></div>';
    }).join("") : '<div class="empty">No sessions scheduled yet <span class="zh">尚未安排課表</span></div>';
    bodyHtml = renderScheduleDayTabs() + '<div class="card">'+body+'</div>';
  }
  return '<section class="section"><div class="section-head"><div>' +
    '<div class="eyebrow">Schedule <span class="zh">課表</span></div><h2 class="section-title">Class Times &amp; Location</h2></div></div>' +
    renderScheduleViewToggle() +
    bodyHtml +
    '</section>';
}

function renderGroupCards(){
  const list = STATE.groups||[];
  const mine = (IDENTITY.name||"").trim().toLowerCase();

    return '<div class="group-card"><div class="group-name">'+esc(g.name)+
      (isMine? ' <span class="pill pill-accent">Your Group <span class="zh">你的分組</span></span>':'')+'</div>'+
      (g.members? '<div class="group-members">'+esc(g.members)+'</div>':'')+
      (g.note? '<div class="group-note">'+esc(g.note)+'</div>':'')+
      '</div>';
  }).join("");
}

function renderAnnouncementsSection(){
  const list = STATE.announcements.slice().sort(function(a,b){
    if(!!a.pinned!==!!b.pinned) return a.pinned? -1:1;

  const body = list.length ? list.map(function(a){
    return '<div class="ann-item"><div class="ann-title-row">' +
      (a.pinned? '<span class="pill pill-stamp">Pinned <span class="zh">置頂</span></span>':'') +

      '</div>';
  }).join("") : '<div class="empty">No announcements yet <span class="zh">目前沒有公告</span></div>';
  return '<section class="section"><div class="section-head section-head-accent"><div>' +
    '<div class="eyebrow">Announcements <span class="zh">公告欄</span></div><h2 class="section-title">Latest Announcements</h2></div></div>' +
    '<div class="card">'+body+'</div></section>';
}

// Shared "who are you" picker used by both the Assignments and Ask a Question
// sections: a dropdown of the roster (so students don't have to type their ID
// and name by hand) with a manual fallback for anyone not on the list yet.
function renderIdentityPicker(prefix){
  const matched = IDENTITY.no ? STATE.students.find(function(s){return s.no===IDENTITY.no;}) : null;
  const selected = matched ? matched.id : ((IDENTITY.no || IDENTITY.name) ? "__other__" : "");
  const showManual = selected === "__other__";
  const options = STATE.students.slice().sort(function(a,b){return String(a.no).localeCompare(String(b.no),"en");})
    .map(function(s){
      return '<option value="'+esc(s.id)+'"'+(selected===s.id?' selected':'')+'>'+esc(s.no)+' — '+esc(s.name)+'</option>';
    }).join("");
  return '<label class="field">Your Name <span class="zh">你的姓名</span>'+
    '<select id="'+prefix+'-select" data-role="identity-select">'+
    '<option value=""'+(selected===""?' selected':'')+'>— Select your name — 請選擇姓名 —</option>'+
    options+
    '<option value="__other__"'+(selected==="__other__"?' selected':'')+'>Not on the list 名單上沒有我</option>'+
    '</select></label>'+
    '<div class="grid-2" id="'+prefix+'-manual"'+(showManual?'':' hidden')+' style="margin-top:8px;">'+
    '<label class="field">Student ID <span class="zh">學號</span><input id="'+prefix+'-no-manual" value="'+esc(IDENTITY.no)+'" placeholder="e.g. S01"></label>'+
    '<label class="field">Name <span class="zh">姓名</span><input id="'+prefix+'-name-manual" value="'+esc(IDENTITY.name)+'" placeholder="e.g. Alex Chen"></label>'+
    '</div>';
}
function getStudentIdentity(prefix){
  const sel = document.getElementById(prefix+"-select");
  if(sel && sel.value && sel.value!=="__other__"){
    const stu = STATE.students.find(function(s){return s.id===sel.value;});
    if(stu) return {no:stu.no, name:stu.name};
  }
  const noEl = document.getElementById(prefix+"-no-manual");
  const nameEl = document.getElementById(prefix+"-name-manual");
  return {no: noEl?noEl.value.trim():"", name: nameEl?nameEl.value.trim():""};
}

// Looks up which instructor-defined group a student belongs to by name, so
// submissions are tagged automatically instead of asking the student to pick
// their own group from a dropdown.
function findGroupForIdentity(name){
  const lname = (name||"").trim().toLowerCase();
  if(!lname) return "";
  const g = (STATE.groups||[]).find(function(g){
    return (g.members||"").toLowerCase().indexOf(lname)>-1;
  });
  return g? g.name : "";
}
function renderAssignmentsSection(){
  const list = STATE.assignments.slice().sort(function(a,b){return a.dueAt.localeCompare(b.dueAt);});
  const idCard = '<div class="card res-identity-card" style="margin-bottom:10px;">'+
    '<div class="section-sub" style="margin-bottom:8px;"><b>Your Name <span class="zh">你的姓名</span></b> — select once so we know who is reporting a submission below. Your group is detected automatically from the instructor’s group list. Saved only in your browser. <span class="zh">請在此選擇一次姓名，系統會知道是誰在回報作業，組別將依老師建立的分組名單自動判斷，僅儲存於你的瀏覽器。</span></div>'+
    renderIdentityPicker("assign")+
    '</div>';
  const items = list.length ? list.map(function(a){
    const st = dueStatus(a.dueAt);
    const sub = STATE.submissions.find(function(r){return r.assignmentId===a.id && r.studentNo && IDENTITY.no && r.studentNo===IDENTITY.no;});
    return '<div class="assign-item">' +
      '<div class="assign-head"><div><div class="assign-title">'+esc(a.title)+'</div>' +
      '<div class="assign-due">Due <span class="zh">截止</span>：'+esc(fmtDateTime(a.dueAt))+
      ' <span class="countdown" data-due="'+esc(a.dueAt)+'">'+fmtCountdown(a.dueAt)+'</span></div></div>' +
      '<span class="pill '+st.cls+'">'+st.label+'</span></div>' +
      (a.description? '<div class="assign-desc">'+esc(a.description)+'</div>':'') +
      '<div class="assign-actions">' +
      (a.uploadUrl? '<a class="btn btn-stamp" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="'+esc(a.uploadUrl)+'">Go to Upload <span class="zh">前往上傳</span> ↗</a>':'<span class="pill pill-muted">Upload link not set <span class="zh">尚未設定連結</span></span>') +
      '<button class="btn" data-action="toggle-submit-box" data-id="'+a.id+'">'+(sub? 'Update <span class="zh">更新回報</span>':'Mark Submitted <span class="zh">回報已繳交</span>')+'</button>' +
      (sub? '<span class="pill pill-success">Submitted <span class="zh">已回報</span> '+esc(fmtDateTime(sub.submittedAt))+(sub.studentGroup? ' · '+esc(sub.studentGroup):'')+'</span>':'') +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="submit-box" id="submit-box-'+a.id+'">' +
      '<label class="field">Notes / link (optional) <span class="zh">備註／連結（選填）</span><textarea id="note-'+a.id+'" placeholder="e.g. paste your file link so your instructor can check it">'+esc(sub? sub.note:"")+'</textarea></label>' +
      '<div class="btn-row" style="margin-top:8px;"><button class="btn btn-primary" data-action="submit-assignment" data-id="'+a.id+'">Confirm <span class="zh">確認回報</span></button></div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '</div>';
  }).join("") : '<div class="empty">No assignments yet <span class="zh">目前沒有作業</span></div>';
  return '<section class="section"><div class="section-head section-head-accent"><div>' +
    '<div class="eyebrow">Assignments <span class="zh">作業繳交</span></div><h2 class="section-title">Assignments &amp; Deadlines</h2></div></div>' +
    idCard + '<div class="card">'+items+'</div></section>';
}

function renderFaqSection(){
  const list = STATE.faqs||[];
  if(!list.length) return "";
  const items = list.map(function(f){
    return '<div class="faq-item"><div class="faq-q">'+esc(f.question)+'</div>'+
      '<div class="faq-a">'+esc(f.answer)+'</div></div>';
  }).join("");
  return '<section class="section"><div class="section-head section-head-accent"><div>' +
    '<div class="eyebrow">FAQ <span class="zh">常見問題</span></div><h2 class="section-title">Frequently Asked Questions</h2></div></div>' +
    '<div class="card">'+items+'</div></section>';
}

function renderQuestionsSection(){
  const mine = STATE.questions.filter(function(q){return IDENTITY.no && q.studentNo===IDENTITY.no;})
    .slice().sort(function(a,b){return b.createdAt.localeCompare(a.createdAt);});
  const form = '<div class="card"><div class="section-sub" style="margin-bottom:8px;">Have a question for the instructor? Ask here — only you and the instructor can see your questions. Your question history is saved in this browser only, so switching devices or clearing browser data will hide past entries; check for replies from the same device/browser you used to ask. <span class="zh">對老師有疑問嗎？在這裡提問，只有你和老師看得到。提問記錄僅儲存在目前使用的瀏覽器，若更換裝置或清除瀏覽器資料將看不到先前的提問，請於同一裝置／瀏覽器查看老師的回覆。</span></div>'+
    renderIdentityPicker("ask")+
    '<form data-form="ask-question" class="stack" style="margin-top:10px;">'+
    '<label class="field">Your Question <span class="zh">你的問題</span><textarea name="message" required placeholder="Ask anything about the course, schedule, or logistics"></textarea></label>'+
    '<div class="btn-row"><button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Submit Question <span class="zh">送出提問</span></button></div>'+
    '</form></div>';
  const list = mine.length ? '<div class="card" style="margin-top:10px;">'+mine.map(function(q){
    return '<div class="qcard"><div class="q-meta">'+esc(fmtDateTime(q.createdAt))+
      (q.reply? ' · <span class="pill pill-success">Answered <span class="zh">已回覆</span></span>':' · <span class="pill pill-muted">Pending <span class="zh">待回覆</span></span>')+'</div>'+
      '<div class="q-msg">'+esc(q.message)+'</div>'+
      (q.reply? '<div class="q-reply"><b>Instructor <span class="zh">老師回覆</span>:</b><br>'+esc(q.reply)+'</div>':'')+
      '</div>';
  }).join("")+'</div>' : '';
  return '<section class="section"><div class="section-head section-head-accent"><div>' +
    '<div class="eyebrow">Ask a Question <span class="zh">提問區</span></div><h2 class="section-title">Questions &amp; Feedback</h2></div></div>' +
    form + list + '</section>';
}

function renderResourcesSection(){
  const c = STATE.course;
  const items = [
    {icon:ICON_PHOTO, url:c.photosUrl, titleEn:"Workshop Photo Album", titleZh:"工作坊花絮相簿", sub:"Photos from the field 活動現場照片"},
    {icon:ICON_DOC, url:c.slidesUrl, titleEn:"Slides &amp; Reference Materials", titleZh:"課程簡報與參考資料", sub:"Slides &amp; handouts 簡報／講義下載"}
  ];
  const cards = items.map(function(it){
    const tag = it.url ? "a" : "div";
    const hrefAttr = it.url ? ' href="'+esc(it.url)+'" target="_blank" rel="noopener"' : "";
    return '<'+tag+' class="media-card'+(it.url?'':' disabled')+'"'+hrefAttr+'>'+
      '<div class="media-icon">'+it.icon+'</div>'+
      '<div><div class="media-title">'+it.titleEn+' <span class="zh">'+it.titleZh+'</span></div>'+
      '<div class="media-sub">'+(it.url? it.sub : 'Coming soon <span class="zh">資料準備中</span>')+'</div></div>'+
      '</'+tag+'>';
  }).join("");
  return '<div class="section-head section-head-accent"><div>' +
    '<div class="eyebrow">Workshop Media <span class="zh">花絮與資源</span></div><h2 class="section-title">Cloud Materials &amp; Handouts</h2></div></div>' +
    '<div class="card"><div class="media-grid">'+cards+'</div></div>';
}

/* ============ admin gate ============ */
function renderAdminGate(){
  if(!STATE.admin.passwordSet){
    return '<div class="section"><div class="card stack" style="max-width:420px;margin:24px auto;">' +
      '<h2 class="section-title">Set Admin Password</h2>' +
      '<p class="muted small">First time here? Set a password to protect the Teacher tab from accidental edits by students or others. This only guards the panel entry — keep this page’s editable link somewhere safe too. <span class="zh">首次使用請設定密碼保護後台，避免誤改資料；此密碼僅為入口保護，請另外妥善保管此頁面的可編輯連結。</span></p>' +
      '<form data-form="setup-password" class="stack">' +
      '<label class="field">New Password <span class="zh">新密碼</span><input type="password" name="pw1" required minlength="4" id="setup-pw1"></label>' +
      '<label class="field">Confirm Password <span class="zh">再輸入一次</span><input type="password" name="pw2" required minlength="4" id="setup-pw2"></label>' +
      '<button class="btn btn-primary btn-block" type="submit">Set Password &amp; Log In <span class="zh">設定並登入</span></button>' +
      '</form></div></div>';
  }
  return '<div class="section"><div class="card stack" style="max-width:420px;margin:24px auto;">' +
    '<h2 class="section-title">Teacher Log In</h2>' +
    '<form data-form="admin-login" class="stack">' +
    '<label class="field">Password <span class="zh">密碼</span><input type="password" name="pw" required id="login-pw"></label>' +
    '<button class="btn btn-primary btn-block" type="submit">Log In <span class="zh">登入後台</span></button>' +
    '</form></div></div>';
}

function renderDeleteBtn(type,id){
  if(UI.confirmDelete && UI.confirmDelete.type===type && UI.confirmDelete.id===id){
    return '<button class="btn btn-sm btn-danger" data-action="confirm-delete" data-type="'+type+'" data-id="'+id+'">Confirm? <span class="zh">確定刪除？</span></button>'+
      '<button class="btn btn-sm" data-action="cancel-delete">Cancel <span class="zh">取消</span></button>';
  }
  return '<button class="btn btn-sm btn-danger" data-action="ask-delete" data-type="'+type+'" data-id="'+id+'">Delete <span class="zh">刪除</span></button>';
}

/* ============ admin shell ============ */
function renderAdminShell(){
  const tabs = [
    ["overview",'Overview <span class="zh">總覽</span>'],["course",'Course &amp; Schedule <span class="zh">課程與課表</span>'],["speakers",'Speakers <span class="zh">講者</span>'],["announcements",'Announcements <span class="zh">公告</span>'],
    ["assignments",'Assignments <span class="zh">作業與繳交</span>'],["students",'Students &amp; Groups <span class="zh">學員與分組</span>'],["faq",'FAQ <span class="zh">常見問題</span>'],["questions",'Questions <span class="zh">學員提問</span>'],["import",'Import Excel <span class="zh">匯入</span>'],["account",'Account <span class="zh">帳號設定</span>']
  ];
  const tabBtns = tabs.map(function(t){
    return '<button class="tabbtn'+(UI.adminTab===t[0]?" active":"")+'" data-action="admin-tab" data-tab="'+t[0]+'">'+t[1]+'</button>';
  }).join("");
  let content;
  switch(UI.adminTab){
    case "course": content = renderAdminCourseSchedule(); break;
    case "speakers": content = renderAdminSpeakers(); break;
    case "announcements": content = renderAdminAnnouncements(); break;
    case "assignments": content = renderAdminAssignments(); break;
    case "students": content = renderAdminStudents(); break;
    case "faq": content = renderAdminFaq(); break;
    case "questions": content = renderAdminQuestions(); break;
    case "import": content = renderAdminImport(); break;
    case "account": content = renderAdminAccount(); break;
    default: content = renderAdminOverview();
  }
  return '<div class="section">' +
    '<div class="section-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">Teacher <span class="zh">老師後台</span></div><h2 class="section-title">Manage Course Content</h2></div>' +
    '<button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" data-action="admin-logout">Log Out <span class="zh">登出</span></button></div>' +
    '<div class="tabs">'+tabBtns+'</div>'+content+
    '</div>';
}

function renderAdminOverview(){
  const totalExpected = STATE.assignments.length * STATE.students.length;
  const submittedCount = STATE.submissions.length;
  const rate = totalExpected>0 ? Math.round(submittedCount/totalExpected*100) : 0;
  const unanswered = STATE.questions.filter(function(q){return !q.reply;}).length;
  const stats = [
    ['Sessions <span class="zh">課表堂數</span>', STATE.schedule.length],
    ['Announcements <span class="zh">公告則數</span>', STATE.announcements.length],
    ['Assignments <span class="zh">作業份數</span>', STATE.assignments.length],
    ['Submission Rate <span class="zh">繳交率</span>', rate+"%"],
    ['Speakers <span class="zh">講者人數</span>', STATE.speakers.length],
    ['Unanswered Questions <span class="zh">待回覆提問</span>', unanswered]
  ];
  const statHtml = stats.map(function(s){
    return '<div class="stat"><div class="stat-label">'+s[0]+'</div><div class="stat-value">'+s[1]+'</div></div>';
  }).join("");
  const updated = STATE.meta && STATE.meta.updatedAt ? esc(fmtDateTime(STATE.meta.updatedAt)) : "—";
  const shareUrl = (typeof window!=="undefined" && window.location && window.location.href) || "";
  return '<div class="stat-grid">'+statHtml+'</div>' +
    '<div class="card" style="margin-top:14px;"><div class="card-label" style="margin-bottom:8px;">Quick Links <span class="zh">快速前往</span></div>' +
    '<div class="btn-row">' +
    '<button class="btn" data-action="admin-tab" data-tab="announcements">+ New Announcement <span class="zh">發布公告</span></button>' +
    '<button class="btn" data-action="admin-tab" data-tab="assignments">+ New Assignment <span class="zh">建立作業</span></button>' +
    '<button class="btn" data-action="admin-tab" data-tab="course">Edit Schedule <span class="zh">編輯課表</span></button>' +
    '<button class="btn" data-action="admin-tab" data-tab="import">Import Excel <span class="zh">匯入</span></button>' +
    '</div></div>' +
    '<div class="card" style="margin-top:14px;"><div class="card-label" style="margin-bottom:10px;">Share This Page <span class="zh">分享此頁面</span></div>' +
    '<div class="share-card">' +
    '<canvas id="share-qr" class="share-qr" width="120" height="120"></canvas>' +
    '<div class="share-link-row"><input type="text" readonly id="share-link-input" value="'+esc(shareUrl)+'" placeholder="Link loads once the page is published 頁面發布後會顯示連結"><button class="btn btn-sm" data-action="copy-share-link">Copy Link <span class="zh">複製連結</span></button></div>' +
    '</div>' +
    '<p class="small muted" style="margin-top:8px;">Scan or share this QR code / link so students and speakers can open the page directly — handy for printed handouts or the venue entrance. <span class="zh">掃描或分享此 QR code／連結，方便學員與講者直接開啟頁面，適合印在報到資料上。</span></p>' +
    '<p class="small muted" style="margin-top:6px;">Last updated <span class="zh">最後更新</span>: '+updated+'</p>' +
    '</div>';
}

function renderAdminCourseSchedule(){
  const c = STATE.course;
  const form = '<div class="card"><h3 style="font-size:15px;margin-bottom:10px;">Course Details <span class="zh">課程基本資訊</span></h3>' +
    '<form data-form="course-info" class="stack">' +
    '<label class="field">Course Title <span class="zh">課程名稱</span><input name="title" value="'+esc(c.title)+'" required></label>' +
    '<label class="field">Subtitle <span class="zh">副標題</span><input name="subtitle" value="'+esc(c.subtitle||"")+'"></label>' +
    '<label class="field">Description <span class="zh">課程簡介</span><textarea name="description">'+esc(c.description||"")+'</textarea></label>' +
    '<div class="grid-2">' +
    '<label class="field">Dates <span class="zh">上課日期</span><input name="dateRange" value="'+esc(c.dateRange||"")+'"></label>' +
    '<label class="field">Location <span class="zh">上課地點</span><input name="location" value="'+esc(c.location||"")+'"></label>' +
    '</div>' +
    '<div class="grid-2">' +
    '<label class="field">Slides Link <span class="zh">簡報連結</span><input name="slidesUrl" value="'+esc(c.slidesUrl||"")+'" placeholder="https://drive.google.com/..."></label>' +
    '<label class="field">Photos Link <span class="zh">照片連結</span><input name="photosUrl" value="'+esc(c.photosUrl||"")+'" placeholder="https://drive.google.com/..."></label>' +
    '</div>' +
    '<label class="field">Notes <span class="zh">提醒事項</span><textarea name="contactNote">'+esc(c.contactNote||"")+'</textarea></label>' +
    '<button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit" style="align-self:flex-start;">Save <span class="zh">儲存</span></button>' +
    '</form></div>';

  const l = STATE.logistics || {};
  const logisticsForm = '<div class="card" style="margin-top:14px;"><h3 style="font-size:15px;margin-bottom:10px;">Pre-Arrival Info <span class="zh">行前資訊</span></h3>' +
    '<p class="small muted" style="margin-bottom:10px;">Shown to students as a "Getting There &amp; Staying" section — especially useful for participants traveling from abroad. <span class="zh">顯示於學員頁面的「行前資訊」區塊，對國際參與者特別實用。</span></p>' +
    '<form data-form="logistics" class="stack">' +
    '<label class="field">Transportation <span class="zh">交通方式</span><textarea name="transportation">'+esc(l.transportation||"")+'</textarea></label>' +
    '<label class="field">Accommodation <span class="zh">住宿建議</span><textarea name="accommodation">'+esc(l.accommodation||"")+'</textarea></label>' +
    '<div class="grid-2">' +
    '<label class="field">Wi-Fi Info <span class="zh">網路資訊</span><input name="wifiInfo" value="'+esc(l.wifiInfo||"")+'"></label>' +
    '<label class="field">Emergency Contact <span class="zh">緊急聯絡</span><input name="emergencyContact" value="'+esc(l.emergencyContact||"")+'"></label>' +
    '</div>' +
    '<label class="field">Map Link <span class="zh">地圖連結</span><input name="mapUrl" value="'+esc(l.mapUrl||"")+'" placeholder="https://maps.google.com/..."></label>' +
    '<button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit" style="align-self:flex-start;">Save <span class="zh">儲存</span></button>' +
    '</form></div>';

  const rows = STATE.schedule.slice().sort(function(a,b){return (a.date+a.start).localeCompare(b.date+b.start);});
  const tableRows = rows.map(function(r){
    return '<tr><td class="num">'+esc(fmtDate(r.date))+'</td>'+
    '<td class="num">'+esc(r.start)+(r.end?' – '+esc(r.end):'')+'</td>'+
    '<td>'+esc(r.topic)+'</td><td>'+esc(r.location)+'</td><td>'+esc(r.note)+'</td>'+
    '<td><div class="btn-row"><button class="btn btn-sm" data-action="edit-schedule" data-id="'+r.id+'">Edit <span class="zh">編輯</span></button>'+
    renderDeleteBtn("schedule", r.id)+'</div></td></tr>';
  }).join("");
  const table = '<div class="card" style="margin-top:14px;"><div class="section-head" style="margin-bottom:10px;">'+
    '<h3 style="font-size:15px;">Schedule <span class="zh">課表</span></h3><button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" data-action="new-schedule">+ Add Session <span class="zh">新增時段</span></button></div>'+
    (rows.length? '<div class="table-wrap"><table class="data"><thead><tr><th>Date 日期</th><th>Time 時間</th><th>Topic 主題</th><th>Location 地點</th><th>Notes 備註</th><th>Actions 操作</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+tableRows+'</tbody></table></div>':'<div class="empty">No sessions yet <span class="zh">尚未安排課表</span></div>')+
    '</div>';
  return form + logisticsForm + renderAdminFieldZones() + renderAdminShuttleForm() + renderAdminVisitSites() + table;
}

/* ---- Zone Management: base map image URL + Zone A/B/C editor. Previously
   this content (map image + zone descriptions) was hardcoded in the script;
   it now lives in STATE so teachers can update it here without a code edit,
   e.g. to swap in next year's zones and base map. ---- */
function renderAdminFieldZones(){
  const fw = STATE.fieldWork || {};
  const mapForm = '<div class="card" style="margin-top:14px;"><h3 style="font-size:15px;margin-bottom:10px;">Base Map Image <span class="zh">基地主地圖圖片</span></h3>'+
    '<p class="small muted" style="margin-bottom:10px;">Paste a direct image link (ending in .jpg/.png/.webp, e.g. an uploaded Drive/Imgur image set to "anyone with the link can view"). Leave blank to keep the built-in default map. <span class="zh">貼上圖片直連網址（副檔名為 .jpg/.png/.webp，例如設定為「知道連結者皆可檢視」的雲端圖片）。留空則沿用內建預設地圖。</span></p>'+
    '<form data-form="fieldwork-map" class="stack">'+
    '<label class="field">Base Map URL <span class="zh">基地主地圖圖片網址</span><input name="baseMapImageUrl" value="'+esc(fw.baseMapImageUrl||"")+'" placeholder="https://..."></label>'+
    '<button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit" style="align-self:flex-start;">Save <span class="zh">儲存</span></button>'+
    '</form></div>';

  const list = (STATE.fieldZones||[]).slice();
  const rows = list.map(function(z){
    return '<div class="group-card"><div class="group-name">Zone '+esc(z.key||"?")+' <span class="dot" style="background:var(--zone-'+esc(z.color||"a")+')"></span> '+
      esc(z.titleEn)+(z.titleZh? ' <span class="zh">'+esc(z.titleZh)+'</span>':'')+
      (z.groupLabel? ' <span class="pill pill-accent" style="margin-left:6px;">'+esc(z.groupLabel)+'</span>':'')+
      '</div>'+
      (z.boundaryEn||z.boundaryZh? '<div class="group-note">'+esc(z.boundaryEn)+(z.boundaryZh? ' '+esc(z.boundaryZh):'')+'</div>':'')+
      (z.descEn||z.descZh? '<div class="group-members">'+esc(z.descEn)+(z.descZh? ' '+esc(z.descZh):'')+'</div>':'')+
      '<div class="btn-row" style="margin-top:8px;">'+
      '<button class="btn btn-sm" data-action="edit-zone" data-id="'+z.id+'">Edit <span class="zh">編輯</span></button>'+
      renderDeleteBtn("zone", z.id)+
      '</div></div>';
  }).join("");
  const zonesCard = '<div class="card" style="margin-top:14px;"><div class="section-head" style="margin-bottom:10px;">'+
    '<h3 style="font-size:15px;">Zone Management <span class="zh">議題分區管理</span></h3><button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" data-action="new-zone">+ Add Zone <span class="zh">新增分區</span></button></div>'+
    (list.length? rows : '<div class="empty">No zones yet <span class="zh">尚未建立議題分區</span></div>')+
    '</div>';
  return mapForm + zonesCard;
}

function renderAdminShuttleForm(){
  const sh = STATE.shuttle || {};
  const ob = sh.outbound || {stopA:"",stopB:"",trips:[]};
  const ib = sh.inbound || {stopA:"",stopB:"",trips:[]};
  return '<div class="card" style="margin-top:14px;"><h3 style="font-size:15px;margin-bottom:10px;">Shuttle Schedule <span class="zh">接駁車時刻表</span></h3>'+
    '<p class="small muted" style="margin-bottom:10px;">One trip per line, format: departure time,arrival time,bus label (e.g. 12:00,12:15,902 outbound). <span class="zh">每行一個班次，格式：出發時間,抵達時間,班次名稱（例如 12:00,12:15,902 去程）。</span></p>'+
    '<form data-form="shuttle" class="stack">'+
    '<div class="card-label">Outbound <span class="zh">去程</span></div>'+
    '<div class="grid-2">'+
    '<label class="field">Departure Stop <span class="zh">出發站</span><input name="ob-stopA" value="'+esc(ob.stopA||"")+'"></label>'+
    '<label class="field">Arrival Stop <span class="zh">抵達站</span><input name="ob-stopB" value="'+esc(ob.stopB||"")+'"></label>'+
    '</div>'+
    '<label class="field">Trips <span class="zh">班次列表</span><textarea name="ob-trips" rows="6" placeholder="12:00,12:15,902 去程">'+esc(shuttleTripsToText(ob.trips))+'</textarea></label>'+
    '<label class="field">Google Maps Directions URL <span class="zh">Google 地圖路線連結</span><input name="ob-directionsUrl" value="'+esc(ob.directionsUrl||"")+'" placeholder="https://www.google.com/maps/dir/..."></label>'+
    '<div class="divider"></div>'+
    '<div class="card-label">Return <span class="zh">回程</span></div>'+
    '<div class="grid-2">'+
    '<label class="field">Departure Stop <span class="zh">出發站</span><input name="ib-stopA" value="'+esc(ib.stopA||"")+'"></label>'+
    '<label class="field">Arrival Stop <span class="zh">抵達站</span><input name="ib-stopB" value="'+esc(ib.stopB||"")+'"></label>'+
    '</div>'+
    '<label class="field">Trips <span class="zh">班次列表</span><textarea name="ib-trips" rows="10" placeholder="16:08,16:23,101 回程">'+esc(shuttleTripsToText(ib.trips))+'</textarea></label>'+
    '<label class="field">Google Maps Directions URL <span class="zh">Google 地圖路線連結</span><input name="ib-directionsUrl" value="'+esc(ib.directionsUrl||"")+'" placeholder="https://www.google.com/maps/dir/..."></label>'+
    '<button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit" style="align-self:flex-start;">Save <span class="zh">儲存</span></button>'+
    '</form></div>';
}

function renderAdminVisitSites(){
  const list = STATE.visitSites||[];
  const rows = list.map(function(v){
    return '<div class="group-card"><div class="group-name">'+esc(v.name)+
      (v.category? ' <span class="pill '+(CATEGORY_PILL[v.category]||"pill-accent")+'" style="margin-left:6px;">'+esc(v.category)+'</span>':'')+
      '</div>'+
      (v.desc? '<div class="group-note">'+esc(v.desc)+'</div>':'')+
      (v.url? '<div class="group-members">'+esc(v.url)+'</div>':'<div class="group-note">Map link not set yet <span class="zh">尚未設定地圖連結</span></div>')+
      (v.resourceUrl? '<div class="group-members">'+esc(v.resourceUrl)+'</div>':'')+
      (v.note? '<div class="group-note">'+esc(v.note)+'</div>':'')+
      '<div class="btn-row" style="margin-top:8px;">'+
      '<button class="btn btn-sm" data-action="edit-visitsite" data-id="'+v.id+'">Edit <span class="zh">編輯</span></button>'+
      renderDeleteBtn("visitsite", v.id)+
      '</div></div>';
  }).join("");
  return '<div class="card" style="margin-top:14px;"><div class="section-head" style="margin-bottom:10px;">'+
    '<h3 style="font-size:15px;">Field Visit Sites <span class="zh">實地參訪地點</span></h3><button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" data-action="new-visitsite">＋ Add Site <span class="zh">新增地點</span></button></div>'+
    (list.length? rows : '<div class="empty">No visit sites yet <span class="zh">尚未新增參訪地點</span></div>')+
    '</div>';
}

function renderAdminAnnouncements(){
  const list = STATE.announcements.slice().sort(function(a,b){
    if(!!a.pinned!==!!b.pinned) return a.pinned? -1:1;
    return b.createdAt.localeCompare(a.createdAt);
  });
  const rows = list.map(function(a){
    return '<div class="ann-item"><div class="ann-title-row">'+
    (a.pinned?'<span class="pill pill-stamp">Pinned <span class="zh">置頂</span></span>':'')+
    '<span class="ann-title">'+esc(a.title)+'</span></div>'+
    '<div class="ann-date">'+esc(fmtDateTime(a.createdAt))+'</div>'+
    '<div class="ann-body">'+esc(a.body)+'</div>'+
    '<div class="btn-row" style="margin-top:8px;">'+
    '<button class="btn btn-sm" data-action="toggle-pin" data-id="'+a.id+'">'+(a.pinned?'Unpin <span class="zh">取消置頂</span>':'Pin <span class="zh">置頂</span>')+'</button>'+
    '<button class="btn btn-sm" data-action="edit-ann" data-id="'+a.id+'">Edit <span class="zh">編輯</span></button>'+
    renderDeleteBtn("ann", a.id)+
    '</div></div>';
  }).join("");
  return '<div class="card"><div class="section-head" style="margin-bottom:10px;">'+
    '<h3 style="font-size:15px;">Manage Announcements <span class="zh">公告管理</span></h3><button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" data-action="new-ann">+ New Announcement <span class="zh">發布公告</span></button></div>'+
    (list.length? rows : '<div class="empty">No announcements yet <span class="zh">尚未發布公告</span></div>')+'</div>';
}

function renderAdminAssignments(){
  const list = STATE.assignments.slice().sort(function(a,b){return a.dueAt.localeCompare(b.dueAt);});
  const items = list.map(function(a){
    const count = STATE.submissions.filter(function(s){return s.assignmentId===a.id;}).length;
    return '<div class="assign-item"><div class="assign-head"><div>'+
      '<div class="assign-title">'+esc(a.title)+'</div>'+
      '<div class="assign-due">Due <span class="zh">截止</span>：'+esc(fmtDateTime(a.dueAt))+' · Upload link <span class="zh">上傳連結</span>：'+(a.uploadUrl?'<a href="'+esc(a.uploadUrl)+'" target="_blank" rel="noopener">'+esc(a.uploadUrl)+'</a>':'Not set 未設定')+'</div></div>'+
      '<span class="pill pill-accent">'+count+' / '+STATE.students.length+' submitted <span class="zh">已回報</span></span></div>'+
      (a.description?'<div class="assign-desc">'+esc(a.description)+'</div>':'')+
      '<div class="btn-row" style="margin-top:8px;">'+
      '<button class="btn btn-sm" data-action="edit-assign" data-id="'+a.id+'">Edit <span class="zh">編輯</span></button>'+
      renderDeleteBtn("assign", a.id)+
      '</div></div>';
  }).join("");
  const listCard = '<div class="card"><div class="section-head" style="margin-bottom:10px;">'+
    '<h3 style="font-size:15px;">Manage Assignments <span class="zh">作業管理</span></h3><button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" data-action="new-assign">+ New Assignment <span class="zh">建立作業</span></button></div>'+
    (list.length?items:'<div class="empty">No assignments yet <span class="zh">尚未建立作業</span></div>')+'</div>';

  const filterOptions = '<option value="">All assignments 全部作業</option>'+STATE.assignments.map(function(a){
    return '<option value="'+a.id+'"'+(UI.subFilter===a.id?' selected':'')+'>'+esc(a.title)+'</option>';
  }).join("");
  const filterId = UI.subFilter||"";
  let matrixRows = "";
  STATE.students.forEach(function(stu){
    STATE.assignments.forEach(function(a){
      if(filterId && a.id!==filterId) return;
      const sub = STATE.submissions.find(function(s){return s.assignmentId===a.id && s.studentNo===stu.no;});
      matrixRows += '<tr><td>'+esc(a.title)+'</td><td class="num">'+esc(stu.no)+'</td><td>'+esc(stu.name)+'</td>'+
        '<td>'+(sub&&sub.studentGroup?esc(sub.studentGroup):"—")+'</td>'+
        '<td>'+(sub?'<span class="pill pill-success">Submitted 已繳交</span>':'<span class="pill pill-muted">Not submitted 未繳交</span>')+'</td>'+
        '<td class="num">'+(sub?esc(fmtDateTime(sub.submittedAt)):"—")+'</td>'+
        '<td>'+(sub&&sub.note?esc(sub.note):"—")+'</td></tr>';
    });
  });
  const matrixCard = '<div class="card" style="margin-top:14px;"><div class="section-head" style="margin-bottom:10px;">'+
    '<h3 style="font-size:15px;">Submission Overview <span class="zh">繳交狀況總覽</span></h3>'+
    '<div class="btn-row"><select id="sub-filter" class="btn btn-sm" style="cursor:pointer;">'+filterOptions+'</select>'+
    '<button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" data-action="export-csv">Export CSV <span class="zh">匯出</span></button></div></div>'+
    (STATE.students.length && STATE.assignments.length ?
      '<div class="table-wrap"><table class="data"><thead><tr><th>Assignment 作業</th><th>ID 學號</th><th>Name 姓名</th><th>Group 組別</th><th>Status 狀態</th><th>Submitted At 繳交時間</th><th>Notes 備註</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+matrixRows+'</tbody></table></div>'
      : '<div class="empty">No students or assignments yet <span class="zh">尚未有學員名單或作業</span></div>')+
    '</div>';
  return listCard + matrixCard;
}

function renderAdminStudents(){
  const rows = STATE.students.slice().sort(function(a,b){return String(a.no).localeCompare(String(b.no),"zh-Hant");});
  const tr = rows.map(function(s){
    return '<tr><td class="num">'+esc(s.no)+'</td><td>'+esc(s.name)+'</td>'+
    '<td><div class="btn-row"><button class="btn btn-sm" data-action="edit-student" data-id="'+s.id+'">Edit <span class="zh">編輯</span></button>'+
    renderDeleteBtn("student", s.id)+'</div></td></tr>';
  }).join("");
  const studentsCard = '<div class="card"><div class="section-head" style="margin-bottom:10px;">'+
    '<h3 style="font-size:15px;">Students <span class="zh">學員名單</span></h3><button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" data-action="new-student">＋ Add Student <span class="zh">新增學員</span></button></div>'+
    (rows.length? '<div class="table-wrap"><table class="data"><thead><tr><th>ID <span class="zh">學號</span></th><th>Name <span class="zh">姓名</span></th><th>Actions <span class="zh">操作</span></th></tr></thead><tbody>'+tr+'</tbody></table></div>' : '<div class="empty">No students yet <span class="zh">尚未建立學員名單</span></div>')+
    '<p class="small muted" style="margin-top:10px;">For bulk import, use the "Import Excel" tab. <span class="zh">大量匯入請至「匯入 Excel」頁籤。</span></p></div>';

  const groups = STATE.groups||[];
  const groupCards = groups.map(function(g){
    return '<div class="group-card"><div class="group-name">'+esc(g.name)+'</div>'+
      (g.members? '<div class="group-members">'+esc(g.members)+'</div>':'')+
      (g.note? '<div class="group-note">'+esc(g.note)+'</div>':'')+
      '<div class="btn-row" style="margin-top:8px;">'+
      '<button class="btn btn-sm" data-action="edit-group" data-id="'+g.id+'">Edit <span class="zh">編輯</span></button>'+
      renderDeleteBtn("group", g.id)+
      '</div></div>';
  }).join("");
  const groupsCard = '<div class="card" style="margin-top:14px;"><div class="section-head" style="margin-bottom:10px;">'+
    '<h3 style="font-size:15px;">Groups <span class="zh">分組名單</span></h3><button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" data-action="new-group">＋ Add Group <span class="zh">新增分組</span></button></div>'+
    (groups.length? groupCards : '<div class="empty">No groups yet <span class="zh">尚未建立分組</span></div>')+
    '</div>';

  return studentsCard + groupsCard;
}

function renderAdminQuestions(){

      '</div>'+
      '</div>';
  }).join("");
  return '<div class="card"><h3 style="font-size:15px;margin-bottom:10px;">Student Questions <span class="zh">學員提問</span></h3>'+
    (list.length? items : '<div class="empty">No questions yet <span class="zh">目前沒有提問</span></div>')+
    '</div>';
}

function renderAdminImport(){
  let preview = "";
  if(UI.excelPreview){
    const p = UI.excelPreview;
    const courseKeys = Object.keys(p.course);
    preview = '<div class="card" style="margin-top:14px;">'+
      '<h3 style="font-size:15px;">Import Preview <span class="zh">匯入預覽</span></h3>'+
      (p.warnings.length? '<div class="banner banner-readonly" style="margin-block:10px;">'+p.warnings.map(esc).join("<br>")+'</div>':'')+
      (courseKeys.length? '<dl class="kv-preview" style="margin-top:10px;">'+courseKeys.map(function(k){
        return '<dt>'+esc(COURSE_LABELS[k]||k)+'</dt><dd>'+esc(p.course[k])+'</dd>';
      }).join("")+'</dl>' : '<p class="small muted">No course info was detected. <span class="zh">未解析到課程基本資訊。</span></p>')+
      '<div class="card-label" style="margin-top:12px;">Schedule <span class="zh">課表</span> ('+p.schedule.length+')</div>'+
      '<div class="table-wrap" style="margin-top:6px;"><table class="data"><thead><tr><th>Date <span class="zh">日期</span></th><th>Time <span class="zh">時間</span></th><th>Topic <span class="zh">主題</span></th><th>Location <span class="zh">地點</span></th></tr></thead><tbody>'+
      p.schedule.slice(0,6).map(function(r){
        return '<tr><td>'+esc(r.date)+'</td><td>'+esc(r.start)+(r.end?'–'+esc(r.end):'')+'</td><td>'+esc(r.topic)+'</td><td>'+esc(r.location)+'</td></tr>';
      }).join("")+
      '</tbody></table></div>'+
      '<div class="card-label" style="margin-top:12px;">Students <span class="zh">學員名單</span> ('+p.students.length+')</div>'+
      '<div class="table-wrap" style="margin-top:6px;"><table class="data"><thead><tr><th>ID <span class="zh">學號</span></th><th>Name <span class="zh">姓名</span></th></tr></thead><tbody>'+
      p.students.slice(0,6).map(function(r){return '<tr><td>'+esc(r.no)+'</td><td>'+esc(r.name)+'</td></tr>';}).join("")+
      '</tbody></table></div>'+
      '<p class="small muted" style="margin-top:8px;">Confirming will overwrite the current course info, schedule and student list (announcements and assignments are unaffected). <span class="zh">確認匯入將會覆蓋目前的課程資訊、課表與學員名單（不會影響公告與作業）。</span></p>'+
      '<div class="btn-row" style="margin-top:10px;">'+
      '<button class="btn btn-primary" data-action="confirm-import">Confirm Import (Overwrite) <span class="zh">確認匯入（覆蓋目前資料）</span></button>'+
      '<button class="btn" data-action="cancel-import">Cancel <span class="zh">取消</span></button>'+
      '</div></div>';
  }
  return '<div class="card"><h3 style="font-size:15px;">Initial Excel Import <span class="zh">Excel 初始化匯入</span></h3>'+
    '<p class="small muted" style="margin-top:6px;">Upload an Excel file with "Course Info", "Schedule" and "Student List" sheets (field names can vary slightly — the system will try to auto-detect them). Best for quick setup the first time; after that, edit directly in this dashboard. <span class="zh">上傳含有「課程資訊」「課表」「學員名單」三個工作表的 Excel 檔（欄位名稱可以有些許差異，系統會自動辨識）。適合第一次使用時快速建置，之後建議直接在後台編輯。</span></p>'+
    '<input type="file" id="excel-file" accept=".xlsx,.xls" style="margin-top:10px;">'+
    '</div>' + preview;
}
