/* ============ modal ============ */
function renderModal(){
  if(!UI.modal) return "";
  const m = UI.modal;
  let title, formHtml;
  if(m.type==="schedule"){
    const d = m.data;
    title = d.id? 'Edit Session <span class="zh">編輯課程時段</span>':'Add Session <span class="zh">新增課程時段</span>';
    formHtml = '<form data-form="schedule" class="stack">'+
      '<input type="hidden" name="id" value="'+esc(d.id||"")+'">'+
      '<div class="grid-2">'+
      '<label class="field">Date <span class="zh">日期</span><input type="date" name="date" value="'+esc(d.date||"")+'" required></label>'+
      '<label class="field">Location <span class="zh">地點</span><input name="location" value="'+esc(d.location||"")+'"></label>'+
      '</div><div class="grid-2">'+
      '<label class="field">Start Time <span class="zh">開始時間</span><input type="time" name="start" value="'+esc(d.start||"")+'" required></label>'+
      '<label class="field">End Time <span class="zh">結束時間</span><input type="time" name="end" value="'+esc(d.end||"")+'"></label>'+
      '</div>'+
      '<label class="field">Topic <span class="zh">主題</span><input name="topic" value="'+esc(d.topic||"")+'" required></label>'+
      '<label class="field">Notes <span class="zh">備註</span><input name="note" value="'+esc(d.note||"")+'"></label>'+
      '<div class="btn-row"><button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Save <span class="zh">儲存</span></button>'+
      '<button class="btn" type="button" data-action="close-modal">Cancel <span class="zh">取消</span></button></div>'+
      '</form>';
  } else if(m.type==="ann"){
    const d = m.data;
    title = d.id? 'Edit Announcement <span class="zh">編輯公告</span>':'Post Announcement <span class="zh">發布公告</span>';
    formHtml = '<form data-form="ann" class="stack">'+
      '<input type="hidden" name="id" value="'+esc(d.id||"")+'">'+
      '<label class="field">Title <span class="zh">標題</span><input name="title" value="'+esc(d.title||"")+'" required></label>'+
      '<label class="field">Content <span class="zh">內容</span><textarea name="body" required>'+esc(d.body||"")+'</textarea></label>'+
      '<label class="field">Link <span class="zh">連結</span><input name="url" value="'+esc(d.url||"")+'" placeholder="https://... (optional)"></label>'+
      '<label class="checkfield"><input type="checkbox" name="pinned"'+(d.pinned?" checked":"")+'> Pin to top <span class="zh">置頂顯示</span></label>'+
      '<div class="btn-row"><button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Save <span class="zh">儲存</span></button>'+
      '<button class="btn" type="button" data-action="close-modal">Cancel <span class="zh">取消</span></button></div>'+
      '</form>';
  } else if(m.type==="assign"){
    const d = m.data;
    title = d.id? 'Edit Assignment <span class="zh">編輯作業</span>':'Create Assignment <span class="zh">建立作業</span>';
    formHtml = '<form data-form="assign" class="stack">'+
      '<input type="hidden" name="id" value="'+esc(d.id||"")+'">'+
      '<label class="field">Assignment Title <span class="zh">作業標題</span><input name="title" value="'+esc(d.title||"")+'" required></label>'+
      '<label class="field">Description <span class="zh">作業說明</span><textarea name="description">'+esc(d.description||"")+'</textarea></label>'+
      '<div class="grid-2">'+
      '<label class="field">Due <span class="zh">截止時間</span><input type="datetime-local" name="dueAt" value="'+esc(d.dueAt||"")+'" required></label>'+
      '<label class="field">Upload Link <span class="zh">上傳連結</span><input name="uploadUrl" value="'+esc(d.uploadUrl||"")+'" placeholder="https://forms.gle/..."></label>'+
      '</div>'+
      '<div class="btn-row"><button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Save <span class="zh">儲存</span></button>'+
      '<button class="btn" type="button" data-action="close-modal">Cancel <span class="zh">取消</span></button></div>'+
      '</form>';
  } else if(m.type==="student"){
    const d = m.data;
    title = d.id? 'Edit Student <span class="zh">編輯學員</span>':'Add Student <span class="zh">新增學員</span>';
    formHtml = '<form data-form="student" class="stack">'+
      '<input type="hidden" name="id" value="'+esc(d.id||"")+'">'+
      '<div class="grid-2">'+
      '<label class="field">ID <span class="zh">學號</span><input name="no" value="'+esc(d.no||"")+'" required></label>'+
      '<label class="field">Name <span class="zh">姓名</span><input name="name" value="'+esc(d.name||"")+'" required></label>'+
      '</div>'+
      '<div class="btn-row"><button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Save <span class="zh">儲存</span></button>'+
      '<button class="btn" type="button" data-action="close-modal">Cancel <span class="zh">取消</span></button></div>'+
      '</form>';
  } else if(m.type==="speaker"){
    const d = m.data;
    title = d.id? 'Edit Speaker <span class="zh">編輯講者</span>':'Add Speaker <span class="zh">新增講者</span>';
    formHtml = '<form data-form="speaker" class="stack">'+
      '<input type="hidden" name="id" value="'+esc(d.id||"")+'">'+
      '<label class="field">Name <span class="zh">姓名</span><input name="name" value="'+esc(d.name||"")+'" required></label>'+
      '<label class="field">Title / Affiliation <span class="zh">頭銜／單位</span><input name="title" value="'+esc(d.title||"")+'"></label>'+
      '<label class="field">Bio <span class="zh">簡介</span><textarea name="bio">'+esc(d.bio||"")+'</textarea></label>'+
      '<label class="field">Photo URL <span class="zh">照片連結</span><input name="photoUrl" value="'+esc(d.photoUrl||"")+'" placeholder="https://..."></label>'+
      '<div class="btn-row"><button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Save <span class="zh">儲存</span></button>'+
      '<button class="btn" type="button" data-action="close-modal">Cancel <span class="zh">取消</span></button></div>'+
      '</form>';
  } else if(m.type==="faq"){
    const d = m.data;
    title = d.id? 'Edit FAQ <span class="zh">編輯問答</span>':'Add FAQ <span class="zh">新增問答</span>';
    formHtml = '<form data-form="faq" class="stack">'+
      '<input type="hidden" name="id" value="'+esc(d.id||"")+'">'+
      '<label class="field">Question <span class="zh">問題</span><input name="question" value="'+esc(d.question||"")+'" required></label>'+
      '<label class="field">Answer <span class="zh">回答</span><textarea name="answer" required>'+esc(d.answer||"")+'</textarea></label>'+
      '<div class="btn-row"><button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Save <span class="zh">儲存</span></button>'+
      '<button class="btn" type="button" data-action="close-modal">Cancel <span class="zh">取消</span></button></div>'+
      '</form>';
  } else if(m.type==="group"){
    const d = m.data;
    title = d.id? 'Edit Group <span class="zh">編輯分組</span>':'Add Group <span class="zh">新增分組</span>';
    const existingMemberNames = (d.members||"").split(/[,，\n]/).map(function(s){return s.trim();}).filter(Boolean);
    const rosterStudents = STATE.students.slice().sort(function(a,b){return String(a.no).localeCompare(String(b.no),"en");});
    function findOtherGroupFor(name){
      const lname = name.trim().toLowerCase();
      const other = (STATE.groups||[]).find(function(g){
        if(g.id===d.id) return false;
        return (g.members||"").split(/[,，\n]/).map(function(s){return s.trim().toLowerCase();}).indexOf(lname)>-1;
      });
      return other? other.name : null;
    }
    const checklistRows = rosterStudents.map(function(s){
      const checked = existingMemberNames.some(function(n){return n.toLowerCase()===s.name.trim().toLowerCase();});
      const otherGroup = findOtherGroupFor(s.name);
      return '<label class="group-member-check'+(checked?' is-checked':'')+'">'+
        '<input type="checkbox" name="memberIds" value="'+esc(s.id)+'"'+(checked?' checked':'')+'>'+
        '<span class="group-member-check-name">'+esc(s.name)+' <span class="muted small">('+esc(s.no)+')</span></span>'+
        (otherGroup? '<span class="pill pill-muted group-member-check-tag">'+esc(otherGroup)+'</span>':'')+
        '</label>';
    }).join("");
    const extraNames = existingMemberNames.filter(function(n){
      return !rosterStudents.some(function(s){return s.name.trim().toLowerCase()===n.toLowerCase();});
    }).join(", ");
    formHtml = '<form data-form="group" class="stack">'+
      '<input type="hidden" name="id" value="'+esc(d.id||"")+'">'+
      '<label class="field">Group Name <span class="zh">分組名稱</span><input name="name" value="'+esc(d.name||"")+'" required placeholder="e.g. Group A"></label>'+
      '<div class="field">Members <span class="zh">組員</span> <span class="small muted">— tick from the roster, no typing needed <span class="zh">從名單勾選即可，不用手動輸入</span></span>'+
      (rosterStudents.length? '<div class="group-member-checklist">'+checklistRows+'</div>' : '<div class="empty" style="padding:14px 0;">No students in the roster yet — add students first. <span class="zh">尚未建立學員名單，請先新增學員。</span></div>')+
      '</div>'+
      '<label class="field">Other members not on roster <span class="zh">名單外的其他組員</span><textarea name="membersExtra" placeholder="Optional — names not in the student list, comma or line separated">'+esc(extraNames)+'</textarea></label>'+
      '<label class="field">Notes <span class="zh">備註</span><input name="note" value="'+esc(d.note||"")+'"></label>'+
      '<div class="btn-row"><button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Save <span class="zh">儲存</span></button>'+
      '<button class="btn" type="button" data-action="close-modal">Cancel <span class="zh">取消</span></button></div>'+
      '</form>';
  } else if(m.type==="visitsite"){
    const d = m.data;
    const catOpts = ["歷史資產","水系紋理","街區意象","庶民生活"];
    title = d.id? 'Edit Visit Site <span class="zh">編輯參訪地點</span>':'Add Visit Site <span class="zh">新增參訪地點</span>';
    formHtml = '<form data-form="visitsite" class="stack">'+
      '<input type="hidden" name="id" value="'+esc(d.id||"")+'">'+
      '<label class="field">Site Name <span class="zh">地點名稱</span><input name="name" value="'+esc(d.name||"")+'" required></label>'+
      '<label class="field">Category <span class="zh">類別標籤</span><select name="category">'+
      '<option value=""'+(!d.category?' selected':'')+'>— <span class="zh">未分類</span> —</option>'+
      catOpts.map(function(c){return '<option value="'+esc(c)+'"'+(d.category===c?' selected':'')+'>'+esc(c)+'</option>';}).join("")+
      '</select></label>'+
      '<label class="field">Description <span class="zh">核心簡介文字</span><textarea name="desc" placeholder="2-3 sentences on the spatial issue 2-3 句話說明空間議題">'+esc(d.desc||"")+'</textarea></label>'+
      '<label class="field">Map Link <span class="zh">地圖連結</span><input name="url" value="'+esc(d.url||"")+'" placeholder="https://maps.google.com/..."></label>'+
      '<label class="field">Resource Link <span class="zh">景點圖資／參考資料連結</span><input name="resourceUrl" value="'+esc(d.resourceUrl||"")+'" placeholder="https://drive.google.com/..."></label>'+
      '<label class="field">Notes <span class="zh">備註</span><textarea name="note">'+esc(d.note||"")+'</textarea></label>'+
      '<div class="btn-row"><button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Save <span class="zh">儲存</span></button>'+
      '<button class="btn" type="button" data-action="close-modal">Cancel <span class="zh">取消</span></button></div>'+
      '</form>';
  } else if(m.type==="zone"){
    const d = m.data;
    title = d.id? 'Edit Zone <span class="zh">編輯議題分區</span>':'Add Zone <span class="zh">新增議題分區</span>';
    const colorOpts = ZONE_COLORS.map(function(c){
      return '<option value="'+c+'"'+((d.color||"a")===c?' selected':'')+'>'+c.toUpperCase()+'</option>';
    }).join("");
    formHtml = '<form data-form="zone" class="stack">'+
      '<input type="hidden" name="id" value="'+esc(d.id||"")+'">'+
      '<div class="grid-2">'+
      '<label class="field">Zone Label <span class="zh">區域代號</span><input name="key" value="'+esc(d.key||"")+'" placeholder="A" required></label>'+
      '<label class="field">Color <span class="zh">色彩標示</span><select name="color">'+colorOpts+'</select></label>'+
      '</div>'+
      '<div class="grid-2">'+
      '<label class="field">Title (EN) <span class="zh">標題（英文）</span><input name="titleEn" value="'+esc(d.titleEn||"")+'" required></label>'+
      '<label class="field">Title (ZH) <span class="zh">標題（中文）</span><input name="titleZh" value="'+esc(d.titleZh||"")+'"></label>'+
      '</div>'+
      '<div class="grid-2">'+
      '<label class="field">Subtitle (EN) <span class="zh">副標題（英文）</span><input name="subtitleEn" value="'+esc(d.subtitleEn||"")+'" placeholder="Optional short tagline"></label>'+
      '<label class="field">Subtitle (ZH) <span class="zh">副標題（中文）</span><input name="subtitleZh" value="'+esc(d.subtitleZh||"")+'" placeholder="選填，簡短標語"></label>'+
      '</div>'+
      '<div class="grid-2">'+
      '<label class="field">Boundary (EN) <span class="zh">地理邊界說明（英文）</span><input name="boundaryEn" value="'+esc(d.boundaryEn||"")+'" placeholder="e.g. Mapped to XX Rd / XX Creek"></label>'+
      '<label class="field">Boundary (ZH) <span class="zh">地理邊界說明（中文）</span><input name="boundaryZh" value="'+esc(d.boundaryZh||"")+'" placeholder="例：對應 XX 路／XX 溪"></label>'+
      '</div>'+
      '<label class="field">Corresponding Group <span class="zh">對應組別</span><input name="groupLabel" value="'+esc(d.groupLabel||"")+'" placeholder="e.g. G1 第一組"></label>'+
      '<div class="grid-2">'+
      '<label class="field">Description (EN) <span class="zh">內文描述（英文）</span><textarea name="descEn" placeholder="Optional — a fuller paragraph shown under the boundary line">'+esc(d.descEn||"")+'</textarea></label>'+
      '<label class="field">Description (ZH) <span class="zh">內文描述（中文）</span><textarea name="descZh" placeholder="選填，顯示於邊界說明下方的完整段落">'+esc(d.descZh||"")+'</textarea></label>'+
      '</div>'+
      '<div class="btn-row"><button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Save <span class="zh">儲存</span></button>'+
      '<button class="btn" type="button" data-action="close-modal">Cancel <span class="zh">取消</span></button></div>'+
      '</form>';
  } else { return ""; }
  return '<div class="modal-overlay" data-action="modal-overlay"><div class="modal-card">'+
    '<div class="modal-head"><h3 class="modal-title">'+title+'</h3>'+
    '<button class="modal-close" data-action="close-modal">✕</button></div>'+
    formHtml+'</div></div>';
}

/* ============ delete confirm dispatcher ============ */
function doConfirmedDelete(type,id){
  UI.confirmDelete = null;
  const map = {schedule:"SCHEDULE_DELETE", ann:"ANN_DELETE", assign:"ASSIGN_DELETE", student:"STUDENT_DELETE",
    speaker:"SPEAKER_DELETE", faq:"FAQ_DELETE", group:"GROUP_DELETE", question:"QUESTION_DELETE",
    visitsite:"VISITSITE_DELETE", zone:"ZONE_DELETE"};
  const at = map[type];
  if(at) dispatch({type:at, payload:{id:id}});
}

/* ============ share QR (drawn after each render, if the canvas is present) ============ */
function drawShareQr(){
  try{
    const canvas = document.getElementById("share-qr");
    if(!canvas || typeof QRious==="undefined") return;
    const url = (typeof window!=="undefined" && window.location && window.location.href) || "";
    if(!url) return;
    new QRious({element:canvas, value:url, size:120, background:"#fff", foreground:"#141413"});
  }catch(e){}
}
function copyShareLink(){
  const url = (typeof window!=="undefined" && window.location && window.location.href) || "";
  if(!url) return;
  try{
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(function(){
      showToast("Link copied. 已複製連結","success");
    }).catch(function(){
      showToast("Couldn't copy — please copy the address bar link manually. 複製失敗，請手動複製網址列連結","danger");
    });
  }catch(e){
    showToast("Couldn't copy — please copy the address bar link manually. 複製失敗，請手動複製網址列連結","danger");
  }
}
function gcalUrl(session){
  const digits = function(s){return String(s||"").replace(/[^0-9]/g,"");};
  const datePart = digits(session.date);
  const startT = (session.start||"09:00").replace(":","")+"00";
  const endT = (session.end||session.start||"10:00").replace(":","")+"00";
  const dates = datePart+"T"+startT+"/"+datePart+"T"+endT;
  const params = "action=TEMPLATE&text="+encodeURIComponent(session.topic||"")+
    "&dates="+dates+
    "&details="+encodeURIComponent(session.note||"")+
    "&location="+encodeURIComponent(session.location||"")+
    "&ctz="+encodeURIComponent("Asia/Taipei");
  return "https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render?"+params;
}

/* ============ assignment submission ============ */
function handleSubmitAssignment(assignId){
  const identity = getStudentIdentity("assign");
  const no = identity.no, name = identity.name;
  const noteEl = document.getElementById("note-"+assignId);
  const note = noteEl? noteEl.value : "";
  if(!no || !name){
    showToast("Please select your name first. 請先選擇你的姓名","danger");
    return;
  }
  IDENTITY = {no:no, name:name};
  saveIdentity(IDENTITY);
  const group = findGroupForIdentity(name);
  dispatch({type:"SUBMIT_ASSIGNMENT", payload:{assignmentId:assignId, studentNo:no, studentName:name, studentGroup:group, note:note}});
}

/* ============ question reply (admin) ============ */
function handleSaveReply(questionId){
  const el = document.getElementById("reply-"+questionId);
  const reply = el? el.value.trim() : "";
  if(!reply) return;
  dispatch({type:"QUESTION_REPLY", payload:{id:questionId, reply:reply}});
}

/* ============ excel import ============ */
function excelCellToTimeStr(v){
  if(v instanceof Date){
    const p=function(n){return String(n).padStart(2,"0");};
    return p(v.getHours())+":"+p(v.getMinutes());
  }
  if(typeof v === "number"){
    const totalMin = Math.round(v*24*60);
    const h = Math.floor(totalMin/60)%24, m = totalMin%60;
    const p=function(n){return String(n).padStart(2,"0");};
    return p(h)+":"+p(m);
  }
  const s = String(v||"").trim();
  const m = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/);
  if(m) return m[1].padStart(2,"0")+":"+m[2];
  return s;
}
function excelCellToDateStr(v){
  if(v instanceof Date){
    const p=function(n){return String(n).padStart(2,"0");};
    return v.getFullYear()+"-"+p(v.getMonth()+1)+"-"+p(v.getDate());
  }
  const s = String(v||"").trim();
  const m = s.match(/^(\d{4})[\/\-.](\d{1,2})[\/\-.](\d{1,2})/);
  if(m) return m[1]+"-"+m[2].padStart(2,"0")+"-"+m[3].padStart(2,"0");
  return s;
}
function isSeparatorCell(v){
  return /^[\s:：\-–—]*$/.test(String(v===undefined||v===null?"":v));
}
function parseCourseSheet(sheet){
  const rows = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(sheet, {header:1, defval:""});
  const course = {};
  rows.forEach(function(r){
    if(!r || r.length<2) return;
    for(let i=0;i<r.length-1;i++){
      const field = matchAlias(r[i], FIELD_ALIASES.course);
      if(!field || course[field]) continue; // first match for a field wins
      let val = "";
      for(let j=i+1;j<r.length;j++){
        const cell = String(r[j]===undefined||r[j]===null?"":r[j]).trim();
        if(!cell || isSeparatorCell(cell)) continue;
        val = cell;
        break;
      }
      if(val){ course[field] = val; break; }
    }
  });
  // fallback: many real sheets lead with the course/workshop name as a plain
  // heading rather than a labelled "欄位：內容" row. If no title was matched
  // by label, use the first sizeable line of text in the sheet instead.
  if(!course.title){
    outer:
    for(let ri=0; ri<Math.min(rows.length,15); ri++){
      const r = rows[ri];
      if(!r) continue;
      for(let ci=0; ci<r.length; ci++){
        const v = String(r[ci]===undefined||r[ci]===null?"":r[ci]).trim();
        if(v.length>=4 && v.length<=80){
          course.title = v;
          break outer;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return course;
}
function parseScheduleSheet(sheet){
  const rows = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(sheet, {defval:""});
  const out = [];
  rows.forEach(function(r){
    const rec = {};
    Object.keys(r).forEach(function(h){
      const field = matchAlias(h, FIELD_ALIASES.schedule);
      if(field) rec[field]=r[h];
    });
    if(!rec.date && !rec.topic) return;
    out.push({
      id: uid("sc"),
      date: excelCellToDateStr(rec.date),
      start: rec.start? excelCellToTimeStr(rec.start):"",
      end: rec.end? excelCellToTimeStr(rec.end):"",
      topic: String(rec.topic||"").trim(),
      location: String(rec.location||"").trim(),
      note: String(rec.note||"").trim()
    });
  });
  out.sort(function(a,b){return (a.date+a.start).localeCompare(b.date+b.start);});
  return out;
}
function parseRosterSheet(sheet){
  const rows = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(sheet, {defval:""});
  const out = [];
  let seq=1;
  rows.forEach(function(r){
    const rec = {};
    Object.keys(r).forEach(function(h){
      const field = matchAlias(h, FIELD_ALIASES.roster);
      if(field) rec[field]=r[h];
    });
    const name = String(rec.name||"").trim();
    if(!name) return;
    let no = String(rec.no||"").trim();
    if(!no){ no = "S"+String(seq).padStart(2,"0"); }
    seq++;
    out.push({id:uid("st"), no:no, name:name});
  });
  return out;
}
function classifyAndParseWorkbook(wb){
  const names = wb.SheetNames;
  let courseSheet=null, scheduleSheet=null, rosterSheet=null;
  const courseKw=["課程資訊","課程介紹","基本資訊","課程說明","course","info"];
  const schedKw=["課表","時間表","schedule","行事曆","日程","時程","行程"];
  const rosterKw=["學員","名單","roster","學生","選課"];
  names.forEach(function(n){
    const nn = n.toLowerCase();
    if(!courseSheet && courseKw.some(function(k){return nn.indexOf(k.toLowerCase())>-1;})) courseSheet=n;
    else if(!scheduleSheet && schedKw.some(function(k){return nn.indexOf(k.toLowerCase())>-1;})) scheduleSheet=n;
    else if(!rosterSheet && rosterKw.some(function(k){return nn.indexOf(k.toLowerCase())>-1;})) rosterSheet=n;
  });
  const warnings = [];
  // Positional fallback (guessing an unmatched slot from sheet order) is only
  // safe for a small, purpose-built workbook. A larger workbook is more likely
  // a general planning file with many unrelated sheets (budget, logistics,
  // venue notes, ...) where guessing by position would silently import the
  // wrong sheet's content, so we leave the slot unmatched instead.
  if((!courseSheet||!scheduleSheet||!rosterSheet) && names.length>=2 && names.length<=4){
    const remain = names.filter(function(n){return n!==courseSheet && n!==scheduleSheet && n!==rosterSheet;});
    if(!courseSheet && remain.length){ courseSheet=remain.shift(); warnings.push('Using sheet "'+courseSheet+'" as course info, based on sheet order. 依工作表順序將「'+courseSheet+'」視為課程資訊。'); }
    if(!scheduleSheet && remain.length){ scheduleSheet=remain.shift(); warnings.push('Using sheet "'+scheduleSheet+'" as the schedule, based on sheet order. 依工作表順序將「'+scheduleSheet+'」視為課表。'); }
    if(!rosterSheet && remain.length){ rosterSheet=remain.shift(); warnings.push('Using sheet "'+rosterSheet+'" as the student list, based on sheet order. 依工作表順序將「'+rosterSheet+'」視為學員名單。'); }
  }
  let course = {};
  if(courseSheet){ course = parseCourseSheet(wb.Sheets[courseSheet]); }
  else warnings.push("No course info sheet found; course details will not be updated. 找不到課程資訊工作表，將不會更新課程基本資料。");
  let schedule = [];
  if(scheduleSheet){
    schedule = parseScheduleSheet(wb.Sheets[scheduleSheet]);
    if(!schedule.length) warnings.push('No rows were parsed from schedule sheet "'+scheduleSheet+'" — it may use a more complex layout (e.g. dates across columns). Please enter the schedule manually in the "Course & Schedule" tab. 課表工作表「'+scheduleSheet+'」沒有解析到資料列，可能是日期橫向排列等較複雜的表格格式，請至「課程與課表」頁籤手動輸入。');
  } else warnings.push('No schedule sheet found. Please enter the schedule manually in the "Course & Schedule" tab. 找不到課表工作表，請至「課程與課表」頁籤手動輸入課表。');
  let students = [];
  if(rosterSheet){
    students = parseRosterSheet(wb.Sheets[rosterSheet]);
    if(!students.length) warnings.push('No rows were parsed from student list sheet "'+rosterSheet+'". 學員名單工作表「'+rosterSheet+'」沒有解析到任何資料列。');
  } else warnings.push('No student list sheet found. Please enter the student list manually in the "Students" tab. 找不到學員名單工作表，請至「學員名單」頁籤手動輸入。');
  return {course:course, schedule:schedule, students:students, warnings:warnings};
}
function parseExcelFile(file){
  const reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = function(ev){
    try{
      const data = new Uint8Array(ev.target.result);
      const wb = XLSX.read(data, {type:"array", cellDates:true});
      UI.excelPreview = classifyAndParseWorkbook(wb);
      render();
    }catch(err){
      showToast("Could not parse the Excel file — please check its format. Excel 解析失敗，請確認檔案格式","danger");
    }
  };
  reader.onerror = function(){ showToast("Failed to read the file. 讀取檔案失敗","danger"); };
  reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);
}
function confirmImport(){
  if(!UI.excelPreview) return;
  dispatch({type:"IMPORT_EXCEL", payload:UI.excelPreview});
  UI.excelPreview = null;
  showToast("Data imported — check each tab to review. 已匯入資料，可至各頁籤確認內容","success");
}

/* ============ csv export ============ */
async function exportCsv(){
  let downloads = null;
  try{ downloads = await window.claude.use("downloads"); }catch(e){ downloads = null; }
  const rows = [["Assignment","Due","ID","Name","Group","Status","Submitted At","Note"]];
  STATE.assignments.forEach(function(a){
    STATE.students.forEach(function(stu){
      const sub = STATE.submissions.find(function(s){return s.assignmentId===a.id && s.studentNo===stu.no;});
      rows.push([a.title, fmtDateTime(a.dueAt), stu.no, stu.name, sub?(sub.studentGroup||""):"", sub?"Submitted":"Not submitted",
        sub?fmtDateTime(sub.submittedAt):"", sub?sub.note:""]);
    });
  });
  const csv = "﻿" + rows.map(function(r){
    return r.map(function(cell){
      const s = String(cell===undefined||cell===null?"":cell);
      if(/[",\n]/.test(s)) return '"'+s.replace(/"/g,'""')+'"';
      return s;
    }).join(",");
  }).join("\r\n");
  const filename = "assignment_submissions_"+new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)+".csv";
  if(!downloads){ showToast("Downloads aren't supported in this environment — please save from the browser instead. 目前環境不支援下載，請改用瀏覽器另存。","danger"); return; }
  try{
    await downloads.save({filename:filename, data:csv});
    showToast("CSV exported. 已匯出 CSV","success");
  }catch(err){
    if(err && err.code==="declined") return;
    showToast("Export failed, please try again. 匯出失敗，請再試一次。","danger");
  }
}

/* ============ event delegation ============ */
function onClick(e){
  const el = e.target.closest("[data-action]");
  if(!el) return;
  const action = el.dataset.action;
  switch(action){
    case "switch-role": UI.role = el.dataset.role; UI.modal=null; UI.confirmDelete=null; render(); break;
    case "student-tab": UI.studentTab = el.dataset.tab; render(); break;
    case "schedule-day": UI.scheduleDay = el.dataset.day; render(); break;
    case "schedule-view": UI.scheduleView = el.dataset.view; render(); break;
    case "shuttle-tab": UI.shuttleTab = el.dataset.dir; render(); break;
    case "admin-tab": UI.adminTab = el.dataset.tab; UI.confirmDelete=null; UI.excelPreview = (el.dataset.tab==="import")?UI.excelPreview:null; render(); break;
    case "admin-logout":
      UI.adminUnlocked=false; UI.role="student";
      try{ sessionStorage.removeItem("courseportal_admin_unlocked"); }catch(err){}
      render();
      break;
    case "new-schedule": UI.modal={type:"schedule",data:{}}; render(); break;
    case "edit-schedule": UI.modal={type:"schedule",data: STATE.schedule.find(function(r){return r.id===el.dataset.id;})||{}}; render(); break;
    case "new-ann": UI.modal={type:"ann",data:{}}; render(); break;
    case "edit-ann": UI.modal={type:"ann",data: STATE.announcements.find(function(r){return r.id===el.dataset.id;})||{}}; render(); break;
    case "toggle-pin": dispatch({type:"ANN_TOGGLE_PIN", payload:{id: el.dataset.id}}); break;
    case "new-assign": UI.modal={type:"assign",data:{}}; render(); break;
    case "edit-assign": UI.modal={type:"assign",data: STATE.assignments.find(function(r){return r.id===el.dataset.id;})||{}}; render(); break;
    case "new-student": UI.modal={type:"student",data:{}}; render(); break;
    case "edit-student": UI.modal={type:"student",data: STATE.students.find(function(r){return r.id===el.dataset.id;})||{}}; render(); break;
    case "new-speaker": UI.modal={type:"speaker",data:{}}; render(); break;
    case "edit-speaker": UI.modal={type:"speaker",data: STATE.speakers.find(function(r){return r.id===el.dataset.id;})||{}}; render(); break;
    case "new-faq": UI.modal={type:"faq",data:{}}; render(); break;
    case "edit-faq": UI.modal={type:"faq",data: STATE.faqs.find(function(r){return r.id===el.dataset.id;})||{}}; render(); break;
    case "new-group": UI.modal={type:"group",data:{}}; render(); break;
    case "edit-group": UI.modal={type:"group",data: STATE.groups.find(function(r){return r.id===el.dataset.id;})||{}}; render(); break;
    case "new-visitsite": UI.modal={type:"visitsite",data:{}}; render(); break;
    case "edit-visitsite": UI.modal={type:"visitsite",data: STATE.visitSites.find(function(r){return r.id===el.dataset.id;})||{}}; render(); break;
    case "new-zone": UI.modal={type:"zone",data:{}}; render(); break;
    case "edit-zone": UI.modal={type:"zone",data: STATE.fieldZones.find(function(r){return r.id===el.dataset.id;})||{}}; render(); break;
    case "toggle-reply-box": {
      const box = document.getElementById("reply-box-"+el.dataset.id);
      if(box) box.classList.toggle("open");
      break;
    }
    case "save-reply": handleSaveReply(el.dataset.id); break;
    case "copy-share-link": copyShareLink(); break;
    case "close-modal": UI.modal=null; render(); break;
    case "modal-overlay": if(e.target===el){ UI.modal=null; render(); } break;
    case "ask-delete": UI.confirmDelete={type: el.dataset.type, id: el.dataset.id}; render(); break;
    case "cancel-delete": UI.confirmDelete=null; render(); break;
    case "confirm-delete": doConfirmedDelete(el.dataset.type, el.dataset.id); break;
    case "toggle-submit-box": {
      const box = document.getElementById("submit-box-"+el.dataset.id);
      if(box) box.classList.toggle("open");
      break;
    }
    case "submit-assignment": handleSubmitAssignment(el.dataset.id); break;
    case "export-csv": exportCsv(); break;
    case "confirm-import": confirmImport(); break;
    case "cancel-import": UI.excelPreview=null; render(); break;
  }
}

function onSubmit(e){
  const form = e.target.closest("form[data-form]");
  if(!form) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  const type = form.dataset.form;
  const fd = new FormData(form);
  if(type==="setup-password"){
    const pw1=fd.get("pw1"), pw2=fd.get("pw2");
    if(pw1!==pw2){ showToast("Passwords don't match. 兩次密碼不一致","danger"); return; }
    sha256Hex(pw1).then(function(hash){
      return dispatch({type:"SET_PASSWORD", payload:{hash:hash}});
    }).then(function(){
      UI.adminUnlocked=true;
      try{ sessionStorage.setItem("courseportal_admin_unlocked","1"); }catch(err){}
      render();
    });
    return;
  }
  if(type==="admin-login"){
    const pw = fd.get("pw");
    sha256Hex(pw).then(function(hash){
      if(hash===STATE.admin.passwordHash){
        UI.adminUnlocked=true;
        try{ sessionStorage.setItem("courseportal_admin_unlocked","1"); }catch(err){}
        render();
      } else {
        showToast("Incorrect password. 密碼錯誤","danger");
      }
    });
    return;
  }
  if(type==="change-password"){
    const oldPw=fd.get("old"), pw1=fd.get("pw1"), pw2=fd.get("pw2");
    sha256Hex(oldPw).then(function(oldHash){
      if(oldHash!==STATE.admin.passwordHash){ showToast("Current password is incorrect. 目前密碼不正確","danger"); return; }
      if(pw1!==pw2){ showToast("New passwords don't match. 兩次新密碼不一致","danger"); return; }
      sha256Hex(pw1).then(function(hash){
        dispatch({type:"SET_PASSWORD", payload:{hash:hash}});
        showToast("Password updated. 密碼已更新","success");
      });
    });
    return;
  }
  if(type==="course-info"){
    const payload = {};
    ["title","subtitle","description","dateRange","location","slidesUrl","photosUrl","contactNote"].forEach(function(k){
      payload[k]=fd.get(k)||"";
    });
    dispatch({type:"SET_COURSE", payload:payload});
    return;
  }
  if(type==="schedule"){
    const row = {
      id: fd.get("id") || uid("sc"),
      date: fd.get("date"), start: fd.get("start"), end: fd.get("end")||"",
      topic: fd.get("topic"), location: fd.get("location")||"", note: fd.get("note")||""
    };
    dispatch({type:"SCHEDULE_UPSERT", payload:row});
    return;
  }
  if(type==="ann"){
    const id = fd.get("id");
    const existing = id ? STATE.announcements.find(function(a){return a.id===id;}) : null;
    const row = {
      id: id || uid("an"),
      title: fd.get("title"), body: fd.get("body"), url: fd.get("url")||"",
      pinned: fd.get("pinned")==="on",
      createdAt: existing ? existing.createdAt : nowISO()
    };
    dispatch({type:"ANN_UPSERT", payload:row});
    return;
  }
  if(type==="assign"){
    const id = fd.get("id");
    const existing = id ? STATE.assignments.find(function(a){return a.id===id;}) : null;
    const row = {
      id: id || uid("as"),
      title: fd.get("title"), description: fd.get("description")||"",
      dueAt: fd.get("dueAt"), uploadUrl: fd.get("uploadUrl")||"",
      createdAt: existing ? existing.createdAt : nowISO()
    };
    dispatch({type:"ASSIGN_UPSERT", payload:row});
    return;
  }
  if(type==="student"){
    const row = { id: fd.get("id")||uid("st"), no: fd.get("no"), name: fd.get("name") };
    dispatch({type:"STUDENT_UPSERT", payload:row});
    return;
  }
  if(type==="logistics"){
    const payload = {};
    ["transportation","accommodation","wifiInfo","emergencyContact","mapUrl"].forEach(function(k){
      payload[k]=fd.get(k)||"";
    });
    dispatch({type:"LOGISTICS_SET", payload:payload});
    return;
  }
  if(type==="speaker"){
    const row = {
      id: fd.get("id")||uid("sp"),
      name: fd.get("name"), title: fd.get("title")||"",
      bio: fd.get("bio")||"", photoUrl: fd.get("photoUrl")||""
    };
    dispatch({type:"SPEAKER_UPSERT", payload:row});
    return;
  }
  if(type==="faq"){
    const row = { id: fd.get("id")||uid("fq"), question: fd.get("question"), answer: fd.get("answer") };
    dispatch({type:"FAQ_UPSERT", payload:row});
    return;
  }
  if(type==="group"){
    const idToName = {};
    STATE.students.forEach(function(s){ idToName[s.id]=s.name; });
    const namesFromRoster = fd.getAll("memberIds").map(function(id){return idToName[id];}).filter(Boolean);
    const extraNames = (fd.get("membersExtra")||"").split(/[,，\n]/).map(function(s){return s.trim();}).filter(Boolean);
    const row = {
      id: fd.get("id")||uid("gr"),
      name: fd.get("name"), members: namesFromRoster.concat(extraNames).join(", "), note: fd.get("note")||""
    };
    dispatch({type:"GROUP_UPSERT", payload:row});
    return;
  }
  if(type==="visitsite"){
    const row = { id: fd.get("id")||uid("vs"), name: fd.get("name"), url: fd.get("url")||"", note: fd.get("note")||"",
      category: fd.get("category")||"", desc: fd.get("desc")||"", resourceUrl: fd.get("resourceUrl")||"" };
    dispatch({type:"VISITSITE_UPSERT", payload:row});
    return;
  }
  if(type==="shuttle"){
    const payload = {
      outbound: { stopA: fd.get("ob-stopA")||"", stopB: fd.get("ob-stopB")||"", trips: parseShuttleTripsText(fd.get("ob-trips")), directionsUrl: fd.get("ob-directionsUrl")||"" },
      inbound: { stopA: fd.get("ib-stopA")||"", stopB: fd.get("ib-stopB")||"", trips: parseShuttleTripsText(fd.get("ib-trips")), directionsUrl: fd.get("ib-directionsUrl")||"" }
    };
    dispatch({type:"SHUTTLE_SET", payload:payload});
    return;
  }
  if(type==="zone"){
    const row = {
      id: fd.get("id")||uid("fz"),
      key: fd.get("key")||"", color: fd.get("color")||"a",
      titleEn: fd.get("titleEn")||"", titleZh: fd.get("titleZh")||"",
      subtitleEn: fd.get("subtitleEn")||"", subtitleZh: fd.get("subtitleZh")||"",
      boundaryEn: fd.get("boundaryEn")||"", boundaryZh: fd.get("boundaryZh")||"",
      groupLabel: fd.get("groupLabel")||"",
      descEn: fd.get("descEn")||"", descZh: fd.get("descZh")||""
    };
    dispatch({type:"ZONE_UPSERT", payload:row});
    return;
  }
  if(type==="fieldwork-map"){
    dispatch({type:"FIELDWORK_SET", payload:{baseMapImageUrl: fd.get("baseMapImageUrl")||""}});
    return;
  }
  if(type==="ask-question"){
    const identity = getStudentIdentity("ask");
    const no = identity.no, name = identity.name;
    const message = (fd.get("message")||"").trim();
    if(!no || !name){
      showToast("Please select your name first. 請先選擇你的姓名","danger");
      return;
    }
    IDENTITY = {no:no, name:name};
    saveIdentity(IDENTITY);
    dispatch({type:"QUESTION_SUBMIT", payload:{id:uid("q"), studentNo:no, studentName:name, message:message, createdAt:nowISO(), reply:"", repliedAt:null}});
    showToast("Question submitted. 提問已送出","success");
    return;
  }
}

function onChange(e){
  if(e.target && e.target.id==="sub-filter"){
    UI.subFilter = e.target.value; render();
  }
  if(e.target && e.target.id==="excel-file"){
    const file = e.target.files && e.target.files[0];
    if(file) parseExcelFile(file);
  }
  if(e.target && e.target.dataset && e.target.dataset.role==="identity-select"){
    const prefix = e.target.id.replace(/-select$/,"");
    const manual = document.getElementById(prefix+"-manual");
    if(manual) manual.hidden = (e.target.value !== "__other__");
    if(e.target.value!=="__other__"){
      IDENTITY = getStudentIdentity(prefix);
      saveIdentity(IDENTITY);
      render();
    }
  }
}

document.addEventListener("click", onClick);
document.addEventListener("submit", onSubmit);
document.addEventListener("change", onChange);

/* ============ boot ============ */
(function replayPendingAction(){
  try{
    const raw = sessionStorage.getItem("courseportal_pending_action");
    if(raw){
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      const attempts = parsed.attempts || 1;
      if(attempts > 5){
        sessionStorage.removeItem("courseportal_pending_action");
      } else {
        STATE = applyAction(clone(STATE), parsed.action);
        sessionStorage.setItem("courseportal_pending_action", JSON.stringify({action:parsed.action, attempts:attempts+1}));
        tryPublish();
      }
    }
  }catch(e){}
})();

function start(hotData){
  if(hotData && hotData.ui){
    if(hotData.ui.role) UI.role = hotData.ui.role;
    if(hotData.ui.adminTab) UI.adminTab = hotData.ui.adminTab;
    if(hotData.ui.studentTab) UI.studentTab = hotData.ui.studentTab;
  }
  render();
}

try{
  if(window.claude && window.claude.hot && typeof window.claude.hot.snapshot === "function"){
    window.claude.hot.snapshot(function(){
      return { ui: { role: UI.role, adminTab: UI.adminTab, studentTab: UI.studentTab } };
    });
  }
}catch(e){}

try{
  if(window.claude && window.claude.hot && typeof window.claude.hot.ready === "function"){
    window.claude.hot.ready(start);
  } else {
    start((window.claude && window.claude.hot && window.claude.hot.data) || {});
  }
}catch(e){
  start({});
}
</script>
